library: AI and See Why Keyword Library

keywords.name: 16mm Film Look
keywords.definition: Grainy, slightly soft small-gauge film texture; indie warmth and imperfection.
keywords.when_to_use: Use for memory sequences, music videos, and handmade honesty.
keywords.prompt_example: "16mm film look, summer lake, grain and halation"

keywords.name: 1920s Flapper Dress
keywords.definition: Loose, straight dresses that drop to the hips and stop near the knee, covered in beads, sequins or swinging fringe. Think bobbed hair, long pearls and a feathered headband.
keywords.when_to_use: Use for jazz age parties, speakeasies and dance scenes. Fringe and beads come alive in video when the dancer moves.
keywords.prompt_example: "woman in a beaded 1920s flapper dress, art deco ballroom"

keywords.name: 1940s Wartime Fashion
keywords.definition: Practical style shaped by fabric rationing: padded shoulders, knee-length skirts, neat tailored jackets, headscarves and pinned-up victory roll hairstyles.
keywords.when_to_use: Use for World War II era home front scenes, factories, train stations and letters home. Add the setting so it does not drift into the 1950s.
keywords.prompt_example: "woman in 1940s wartime fashion, padded shoulder jacket and headscarf, railway station"

keywords.name: 1950s New Look
keywords.definition: The postwar silhouette made famous by Christian Dior: soft rounded shoulders, a tiny cinched waist and a full skirt that swings below the knee. Polished, feminine and very structured.
keywords.when_to_use: Use for 1950s glamour, diners, garden parties and vintage ads. Add gloves, a hat or a petticoat for even more period detail.
keywords.prompt_example: "woman in a 1950s new look dress with a full skirt and cinched waist, paris street"

keywords.name: 1960s Mod Fashion
keywords.definition: The bold London look of the mid 1960s: short shift dresses, mini skirts, bright color blocks, black and white graphics, go-go boots and sharp geometric haircuts.
keywords.when_to_use: Use for playful, graphic fashion with a youthful swagger. Works best with clean, simple backgrounds that let the shapes pop.
keywords.prompt_example: "model in a 1960s mod fashion mini dress with black and white stripes, white go-go boots"

keywords.name: 1970s Disco Fashion
keywords.definition: Shiny, flowing clothes made for the dance floor: halter jumpsuits, wrap dresses, wide bell bottoms, platform shoes and gold or silver metallic fabric that catches every light.
keywords.when_to_use: Use for nightclub scenes, mirror balls and dance videos. Pair it with colored light so the shine has something to reflect.
keywords.prompt_example: "dancers in 1970s disco fashion, metallic halter jumpsuits, mirror ball light"

keywords.name: 24mm Wide Lens
keywords.definition: A wide lens that fits lots of the scene into the frame. It makes the viewer feel like they are standing right inside the action.
keywords.when_to_use: Use it to show off a place, or to get close to action while still seeing the whole room. Faces near the edges can look a little stretched, so keep people toward the middle.
keywords.prompt_example: "24mm wide shot of a busy night market, lanterns overhead"

keywords.name: 35mm Lens
keywords.definition: The lens most films use. It sees the world close to how your own eyes do.
keywords.when_to_use: Use it when you are not sure which lens to pick. It almost always works, though it will not give you a dramatic stretched or squashed look.
keywords.prompt_example: "35mm shot of a small robot in a cluttered workshop"

keywords.name: 3D Pavement Art
keywords.definition: Anamorphic chalk illusions on streets that leap into three dimensions from one viewpoint.
keywords.when_to_use: Use for playful trompe-l'oeil scenes and street-art spectacle.
keywords.prompt_example: "3d pavement art of a waterfall in a plaza"

keywords.name: 50mm Lens
keywords.definition: A natural, grounded lens that keeps shapes looking true. It is kind to faces.
keywords.when_to_use: Use it for a classic, realistic look in portraits and conversations. It is a little tight for big rooms, so pick a wider lens when the place matters most.
keywords.prompt_example: "50mm portrait of a baker at her counter, natural perspective"

keywords.name: 90s Anime
keywords.definition: The hand-painted look of anime from the 1990s: soft film grain, slightly faded colors, sharp-cornered hair and moody city nights.
keywords.when_to_use: Use for nostalgic, cinematic anime scenes. Add 'cel animation' to push it further away from glossy modern anime.
keywords.prompt_example: "90s anime still, girl on a rooftop at night, city lights"

keywords.name: 90s Sitcom Set
keywords.definition: The bright living room of a 90s TV comedy: a big couch facing the camera, a kitchen behind it, flat even lighting and a front door everyone bursts through.
keywords.when_to_use: Use for funny, warm, nostalgic scenes where people gather and chat. The flat lighting is part of the charm, so do not expect moody shadows.
keywords.prompt_example: "90s sitcom set, friends on a plaid couch, bright studio lighting"

keywords.name: Abject Art
keywords.definition: Art confronting the discomforting side of the body and decay; beauty's uneasy shadow.
keywords.when_to_use: Use sparingly, for visceral, boundary-pushing fine-art concepts.
keywords.prompt_example: "still life of wilted flowers and spilled milk, abject art"

keywords.name: Absent-Minded Professor
keywords.definition: A brilliant, scattered thinker lost in their own ideas, with glasses pushed up, chalk on one sleeve and papers everywhere.
keywords.when_to_use: Use for cozy, comic or academic scenes full of clutter. Pairs nicely with an -academia mood for a bookish look.
keywords.prompt_example: "absent-minded professor in a cluttered study, chalkboard full of equations"

keywords.name: Abstract Futuristic
keywords.definition: Sleek non-representational forms suggesting speed, tech, and tomorrow: chrome curves and light trails.
keywords.when_to_use: Use for backgrounds, branding, and tech-forward abstract pieces.
keywords.prompt_example: "abstract futuristic composition, chrome and light"

keywords.name: Abstract Romanticism
keywords.definition: Romanticism's awe and emotion expressed through pure shape and color instead of scenery.
keywords.when_to_use: Use for emotional abstracts that swell like landscapes without depicting one.
keywords.prompt_example: "abstract romanticism, storm of color and light"

keywords.name: Abstract Tech
keywords.definition: Circuitry, data, and interface shapes abstracted into pattern and texture.
keywords.when_to_use: Use for tech-brand backgrounds and digital-native abstract art.
keywords.prompt_example: "abstract tech pattern, circuit texture"

keywords.name: -academia
keywords.definition: From dark academia and light academia, -academia wraps a theme in old libraries, tweed, candlelit study and handwritten notes.
keywords.when_to_use: Use for bookish scenes and outfits with a twist. Swap the first word to change the mood, like ocean academia or space academia.
keywords.prompt_example: "ocean academia study, seashells on old books, rainy window"

keywords.name: Accordion
keywords.definition: A stack of rows where clicking one opens it to show more text below, while its little arrow flips. Click again and it folds shut.
keywords.when_to_use: Use it for question and answer sections or long settings, so people only open what they need. Do not hide anything most visitors must read.
keywords.prompt_example: "Build an accordion for my questions section where each row opens smoothly to show its answer and the arrow rotates"

keywords.name: Acid Art
keywords.definition: Psychedelic intensity: melting patterns, electric color, perception turned up too far.
keywords.when_to_use: Use for trippy posters and hallucinatory landscapes.
keywords.prompt_example: "melting forest, acid art, electric colors"

keywords.name: Acidwave
keywords.definition: Vaporwave's harsher cousin: acid-bright gradients, warped grids, digital hallucination.
keywords.when_to_use: Use for retro-digital posters with aggressive color.
keywords.prompt_example: "sunset grid landscape, acidwave"

keywords.name: Aerial Shot
keywords.definition: High drone or helicopter perspective, moving above the world.
keywords.when_to_use: Use for geography, spectacle, and god's-eye storytelling.
keywords.prompt_example: "aerial shot over the coastline at dawn"

keywords.name: Afrovictorian
keywords.definition: Victorian silhouettes and tailoring celebrated through African fabrics, patterns, and presence.
keywords.when_to_use: Use for regal historical-fusion portraits rich in pattern and dignity.
keywords.prompt_example: "portrait of a duchess, afrovictorian style"

keywords.name: Agentic UI
keywords.definition: A calm, chat-first screen where you tell an AI helper what you want and it does the steps for you. Very few buttons, clear results, and elegant Playfair Display headings with a code-style font for small details.
keywords.when_to_use: Use for AI assistant apps, booking helpers or any tool where people hand off a task. Less suited to sites where people want to browse and click around freely.
keywords.prompt_example: "travel booking assistant app, agentic ui, one chat box, results shown as tidy cards"

keywords.name: Albrecht Durer
keywords.definition: (1471-1528) German artist best known for incredibly fine engravings and woodcuts, plus careful nature studies like his famous hare. Crisp lines and patient detail.
keywords.when_to_use: Use for intricate black ink engravings, old book prints and detailed animal studies. Add the word engraving to get his line work.
keywords.prompt_example: "engraving of a knight and a dragon, in the style of Albrecht Durer"

keywords.name: Alexander McQueen
keywords.definition: British designer Alexander McQueen (1969-2010) mixed razor-sharp tailoring with dark, romantic drama: tartan, feathers, lace, skulls and runway shows that felt like theater.
keywords.when_to_use: Use for dramatic, gothic and haunting fashion. It can tip into spooky fast, so add color words if you want it lighter.
keywords.prompt_example: "gown of black feathers and red tartan in the style of alexander mcqueen, misty moor"

keywords.name: Algorave
keywords.definition: Live-coded rave visuals: generative geometry pulsing to algorithmic beats.
keywords.when_to_use: Use for music-visual backdrops and code-driven motion energy.
keywords.prompt_example: "algorave visuals, generative geometry, strobe"

keywords.name: Algorithmic Art
keywords.definition: Art generated by rules and code: systems produce the image, the artist designs the system.
keywords.when_to_use: Use for generative patterns and mathematical beauty.
keywords.prompt_example: "generative pattern, algorithmic art, flowing curves"

keywords.name: Alice in Wonderland
keywords.definition: The curious girl who falls down the rabbit hole, as drawn in the original book's pen and ink pictures: long hair, puffed sleeves and a pinafore over her dress. Describe the book version, not later cartoon or film versions.
keywords.when_to_use: Use for dreamy, topsy-turvy scenes with odd creatures and impossible tea parties. Say 'Victorian engraving style' for the classic book feel.
keywords.prompt_example: "alice in wonderland at a giant tea party, victorian engraving style, mad hatter"

keywords.name: Alphonse Mucha
keywords.definition: (1860-1939) Czech artist of the Art Nouveau poster: graceful women with flowing hair, framed by flowers, halos and curling ornaments in soft colors.
keywords.when_to_use: Use for decorative posters, elegant portraits and ornamental borders. Ask for an Art Nouveau poster to get the full frame.
keywords.prompt_example: "woman with flowing hair framed by a circle of flowers, Art Nouveau poster, in the style of Alphonse Mucha"

keywords.name: Alternative
keywords.definition: Umbrella counterculture styling: band tees, piercings, DIY edge across subcultures.
keywords.when_to_use: Use as a modifier for portraits that should read outside the mainstream.
keywords.prompt_example: "portrait, alternative fashion, 35mm"

keywords.name: American Realism
keywords.definition: Quiet American scenes from the 1920s to the 1950s: diners, hotel rooms and city windows with hard-edged sunlight, flat shadows and people lost in their own thoughts.
keywords.when_to_use: Use for lonely, reflective moments, urban stillness and stories told in a single look out of a window.
keywords.prompt_example: "woman by a window in morning sun, american realism, hard light across an empty room"

keywords.name: Analog
keywords.definition: Pre-digital texture: film grain, tape warble, prints with real physical history.
keywords.when_to_use: Use to warm digital images with tangible imperfection.
keywords.prompt_example: "kitchen scene, analog photo, 1979"

keywords.name: Analytic Cubism
keywords.definition: Early 1900s painting that breaks people and objects into overlapping see-through shards, showing several sides at once, mostly in browns, greys and muted ochre.
keywords.when_to_use: Use for thoughtful, puzzle-like portraits and still lifes, or to show one subject from many angles at once.
keywords.prompt_example: "cafe table with a guitar and a newspaper, analytic cubism, muted browns and greys"

keywords.name: Anamorphic
keywords.definition: Widescreen lenses with oval bokeh, horizontal flares, and gentle edge stretch; instant cinema.
keywords.when_to_use: Use when footage should feel like a theatrical film rather than a video.
keywords.prompt_example: "anamorphic lens, horizontal blue flare across the frame"

keywords.name: Anamorphic Art
keywords.definition: Distorted imagery that resolves correctly only from a specific angle or reflection.
keywords.when_to_use: Use for perspective-trick compositions and hidden-image concepts.
keywords.prompt_example: "anamorphic skull, oblique perspective"

keywords.name: Anatomical Drawing
keywords.definition: Old-style scientific drawings of the human body or animals, showing bones, muscles and organs in fine ink lines, often on yellowed paper with little labels.
keywords.when_to_use: Use for vintage science art, medical themes and curiosity-cabinet looks. Keep it to clean study drawings rather than anything gory.
keywords.prompt_example: "antique anatomical drawing of a human hand showing bones and tendons, ink on aged paper"

keywords.name: Anglo Gothic
keywords.definition: English gothic flavor: stone churches, misty moors, ravens, and restrained dread.
keywords.when_to_use: Use for literary-gothic landscapes and portraits with British weather in their bones.
keywords.prompt_example: "manor on the moors, anglo gothic"

keywords.name: Angura Kei
keywords.definition: Japanese underground theatre fashion: dark vintage kimono elements, dramatic makeup, Showa-era shadow.
keywords.when_to_use: Use for theatrical dark-fashion portraits with Japanese vintage roots.
keywords.prompt_example: "stage portrait, angura kei style"

keywords.name: Animated Gradient Background
keywords.definition: A soft blend of colours slowly drifts and swirls behind a headline, like coloured light moving under frosted glass.
keywords.when_to_use: Use it for a hero section, the big welcome area at the top of a page, when you want calm movement without photos. Keep the text on top strong and readable.
keywords.prompt_example: "Give my hero section an animated gradient background: soft pink, violet and teal blobs slowly flowing behind a white headline and button."

keywords.name: Anime Cel Animation
keywords.definition: TV anime look with crisp linework, hard-edged shadows and painted skies. Calm held poses suddenly snap into action with speed lines, a quick black and white impact flash and a little camera shake.
keywords.when_to_use: Great for action-packed reels, game trailers and dramatic reveals. It needs strong key poses to work, and the impact tricks lose punch if you use them on every beat.
keywords.prompt_example: "10-second action reel, anime cel animation, hero holds then snaps into a punch with radial speed lines and an impact flash"

keywords.name: Anime Light Rays
keywords.definition: The glowing light of modern anime films: towering clouds, beams of sun slicing through windows, soft lens glow and tiny floating specks of light, all brighter and cleaner than real life.
keywords.when_to_use: Use for hopeful, emotional moments, city skies after rain and anything that should feel like a movie poster for a feeling.
keywords.prompt_example: "empty classroom at sunset, anime light rays through the window, floating dust specks"

keywords.name: Anime Watercolor Background
keywords.definition: Soft hand-painted backgrounds from classic Japanese animated films: see-through watercolor washes, puffy summer clouds, grass that sways and sunlight dappling through leaves.
keywords.when_to_use: Use for cozy countryside scenes, nostalgic summer days and any world that should feel gentle and lived-in.
keywords.prompt_example: "hillside cottage on a breezy summer afternoon, anime watercolor background, puffy clouds"

keywords.name: Ansel Adams
keywords.definition: (1902-1984) American landscape photographer famous for huge black and white views of mountains, lakes and Yosemite. Deep blacks, bright whites and every gray in between.
keywords.when_to_use: Use for grand, crisp black and white nature scenes. He shot landscapes, so it helps less with people or color.
keywords.prompt_example: "misty mountain lake, in the style of Ansel Adams, black and white"

keywords.name: Antique Grunge
keywords.definition: Aged elegance gone beautifully to seed: peeling gilt, foxed paper, dusty velvet.
keywords.when_to_use: Use for interiors and still lifes that should feel abandoned but grand.
keywords.prompt_example: "abandoned ballroom, antique grunge"

keywords.name: Antoni Gaudi
keywords.definition: Spanish architect (1852-1926) whose buildings look like they melted, sprouted or grew from the sea. Wavy walls, bone-shaped columns and broken tile mosaics in every color.
keywords.when_to_use: Use when you want a building that feels alive and dreamlike. It can get busy fast, so keep the rest of the prompt simple.
keywords.prompt_example: "cathedral interior like a stone forest, Antoni Gaudi style, colored light"

keywords.name: Ao Dai
keywords.definition: Vietnam's national dress: a long, fitted silk tunic with a high collar and side slits up to the waist, worn over loose flowing trousers. Simple, slim and graceful.
keywords.when_to_use: Use for portraits, city streets and Lunar New Year scenes. Ao dai is worn for Tet, weddings and as a school uniform, and the long panels look lovely moving in the wind.
keywords.prompt_example: "woman in a white ao dai cycling past a hanoi lake, morning mist"

keywords.name: Arc Into Crash Zoom
keywords.definition: The camera curves slowly around the subject, then zooms in hard and fast.
keywords.when_to_use: Use it as punctuation for a big moment. The sudden change in speed is the whole effect, so keep the arc truly slow.
keywords.prompt_example: "a slow arc halfway round a robot, then a sudden crash zoom onto its glowing eye"

keywords.name: Arc Shot
keywords.definition: The camera curves part of the way around the subject.
keywords.when_to_use: Use to bring a still moment to life, or to show a new side of someone.
keywords.prompt_example: "slow arc around her as she reads the letter"

keywords.name: Argyle
keywords.definition: Rows of diamonds with thin diagonal lines crossing over them. Named after Argyll in Scotland, where a clan tartan inspired it, and famous on knit socks and sweaters.
keywords.when_to_use: Use for preppy knits, golf clothes and cozy academic looks. It works best on knitwear, flat surfaces can look like a game board.
keywords.prompt_example: "cozy argyle sweater, autumn library, warm light"

keywords.name: Art Deco and Nouveau Animation
keywords.definition: A 1920s poster engraving itself in gold: symmetrical ornament lines draw outward from the center, sunbursts fan open and elegant type rises into its frame. Everything moves slowly and stately, with no bounce.
keywords.when_to_use: Lovely for luxury brands, invitations, gala openers and vintage title cards. Its slow grandeur can feel stiff for casual or fast social content.
keywords.prompt_example: "10-second gala opener, art deco and nouveau animation, gold sunburst lines fanning out on black, elegant type rising"

keywords.name: Art Deco Era
keywords.definition: The glamorous 1920s-30s look: geometric patterns, gold and black, luxury and symmetry.
keywords.when_to_use: Use for elegance, posters, architecture, and Gatsby-flavored glamour.
keywords.prompt_example: "art deco hotel lobby, gold and black, symmetrical"

keywords.name: Art Nouveau Architecture
keywords.definition: Buildings from around 1900 covered in flowing, plant-like curves: whiplash ironwork, flower-shaped windows and doorways that look like vines.
keywords.when_to_use: Use for romantic, storybook city buildings and metro entrances. Adds lots of detail, so it shines in close or medium views.
keywords.prompt_example: "Art Nouveau cafe facade with curling iron vines, rainy evening"

keywords.name: Art Nouveau Jewelry
keywords.definition: Jewelry from around 1890 to 1910 full of flowing curves: dragonflies, orchids, peacock feathers and women with long hair, often in glowing enamel, opal and gold.
keywords.when_to_use: Use for romantic, nature-inspired jewelry and fantasy accessories. The flowing lines also pair nicely with stained glass and botanical scenes.
keywords.prompt_example: "art nouveau jewelry brooch, enamel dragonfly with opal wings, gold"

keywords.name: Art Povera
keywords.definition: Italian movement making art from humble materials: rags, soil, rope, found scraps as fine art.
keywords.when_to_use: Use for textured, materials-first compositions that feel honest and raw.
keywords.prompt_example: "sculpture of a horse, arte povera style"

keywords.name: Arthur Rackham
keywords.definition: (1867-1939) English illustrator of fairy tales and Peter Pan, full of twisted trees, gnarled roots and tiny fairies. Fine ink lines and faded, earthy watercolor.
keywords.when_to_use: Use for spooky but sweet fairy tale scenes and old storybook pages. The colors are muted, so it will not give you bright pops.
keywords.prompt_example: "fairies hiding in the roots of a twisted oak, in the style of Arthur Rackham"

keywords.name: Artificial Nature
keywords.definition: Nature rebuilt synthetically: plastic flowers, LED forests, lab-grown landscapes.
keywords.when_to_use: Use for uncanny eco-futurist scenes questioning what counts as natural.
keywords.prompt_example: "garden of plastic flowers, artificial nature"

keywords.name: Artistic Web Design
keywords.definition: A bold, gallery-like site with high contrast, daring color choices and showy lettering in the Limelight font. It feels like an art poster you can scroll.
keywords.when_to_use: Use for artists, galleries, music and event sites that want to stand out. Can be hard to read for long text or shopping pages.
keywords.prompt_example: "portfolio site for a painter, artistic web design, black background, one shocking red accent"

keywords.name: ASCII Art
keywords.definition: Pictures drawn entirely with keyboard characters; terminal-era charm.
keywords.when_to_use: Use for retro-computing graphics and text-as-image pieces.
keywords.prompt_example: "cat portrait, ascii art"

keywords.name: Assemblage
keywords.definition: Three-dimensional collage: sculptures built from found objects glued into new meaning.
keywords.when_to_use: Use for textured mixed-object compositions and cabinet-of-curiosities energy.
keywords.prompt_example: "portrait built from vintage objects, assemblage art"

keywords.name: Athleisure
keywords.definition: Sporty clothes worn as everyday wear: leggings, joggers, zip-up tops, soft hoodies and clean sneakers. Comfy, fresh and ready for anything.
keywords.when_to_use: Use for lifestyle, coffee runs, yoga and wellness scenes. Describe colors and fabrics instead of brand names.
keywords.prompt_example: "friends in matching sage green athleisure walking with coffee, morning city street"

keywords.name: Athletic Build
keywords.definition: A strong, fit body with visible muscle from sport or training. Shoulders, arms and legs look capable and ready to move.
keywords.when_to_use: Use for sports, fitness and action scenes for any age or gender. If results look like bodybuilders, say "lean athletic build" or name the sport.
keywords.prompt_example: "woman with an athletic build tying her running shoes, misty track at dawn"

keywords.name: Atmospheric Haze
keywords.definition: Light hangs in the air and the distance fades into soft mist.
keywords.when_to_use: Use for depth, mood and visible beams of light.
keywords.prompt_example: "atmospheric haze, morning light cutting through the trees"

keywords.name: Atmospheric Landscape Painting
keywords.definition: Landscapes where air is the subject: haze, depth, and weather doing the storytelling.
keywords.when_to_use: Use for layered vistas with palpable distance and mood.
keywords.prompt_example: "valley in morning haze, atmospheric landscape painting"

keywords.name: Aubrey Beardsley
keywords.definition: (1872-1898) English illustrator of bold black and white drawings with sweeping curves, big flat black shapes and very fine lines. Elegant, strange and a little wicked.
keywords.when_to_use: Use for striking ink posters, decadent portraits and gothic book art. It is pure black and white, so color prompts fight it.
keywords.prompt_example: "woman in sweeping peacock-feather robes, black ink, in the style of Aubrey Beardsley"

keywords.name: Augmented Reality Art
keywords.definition: Art designed to overlay the physical world: floating layers, digital ghosts in real space.
keywords.when_to_use: Use for mixed-reality concepts and holographic scene ideas.
keywords.prompt_example: "sculpture as AR overlay in a park, augmented reality art"

keywords.name: Avant-Pop Surrealism
keywords.definition: Pop-culture imagery bent into dream logic: glossy, strange, and saturated.
keywords.when_to_use: Use for editorial-weird portraits and album-cover energy.
keywords.prompt_example: "portrait with melting television, avant-pop surrealism"

keywords.name: Average Build
keywords.definition: An ordinary, everyday body: not model-thin, not bulky, just the shape most people actually have. Soft in some places, firm in others.
keywords.when_to_use: Use when the AI keeps giving you glossy, perfect bodies and you want real people. Great for lifestyle and stock-style scenes that need to feel relatable.
keywords.prompt_example: "man with an average build making pancakes in a sunlit kitchen, sweatpants and t-shirt"

keywords.name: Awe
keywords.definition: The feeling of standing before something enormous and beautiful: a tiny figure under a sky full of stars, a waterfall, a cathedral, a whale.
keywords.when_to_use: Use when you want the viewer to feel small in a good way. Make the person tiny and the wonder huge for the biggest effect.
keywords.prompt_example: "awe, tiny hiker beneath a vast glowing aurora, snowy peaks"

keywords.name: Axolotl
keywords.definition: A smiling pink salamander with feathery frills around its head, like a little underwater dragon. Soft, glossy and a bit unreal.
keywords.when_to_use: Use for cute creatures, aquarium scenes and dreamy fantasy pets. Models sometimes add extra legs or frills, so check the details.
keywords.prompt_example: "pink axolotl in a glowing aquarium, macro photography"

keywords.name: Azulejo Tiles
keywords.definition: Painted, glazed ceramic tiles that cover walls, churches and whole building fronts in Portugal. Best known in cobalt blue on white, with swirling flowers and painted scenes.
keywords.when_to_use: Use for sunny architecture, kitchens, patterns and travel scenes. Say 'blue and white' for the classic look, since azulejos come in many colors.
keywords.prompt_example: "Lisbon doorway covered in azulejo tiles, morning light"

keywords.name: Background Swap
keywords.definition: The subject stays exactly in place while the world behind them changes.
keywords.when_to_use: Use to show time passing or a life changing around one person.
keywords.prompt_example: "he stays still while the background cuts from beach to city to snow"

keywords.name: Ballet Arabesque
keywords.definition: A ballerina balanced on one leg with the other stretched straight out behind her, arms reaching long. Graceful and still.
keywords.when_to_use: Use for elegant, poised moments and soft stage scenes. Bodies can bend oddly, so keep the pose simple and the dancer in full view.
keywords.prompt_example: "ballerina in an arabesque, pale tutu, soft stage light, dark background"

keywords.name: Ballroom Waltz
keywords.definition: A couple gliding across a polished floor in a gentle three-step turn, gown flowing out behind. Old-fashioned romance.
keywords.when_to_use: Use for elegant, romantic scenes and grand ballroom moments. Chandeliers and a soft glow complete the feeling.
keywords.prompt_example: "couple in a ballroom waltz, flowing gown, crystal chandeliers, warm glow"

keywords.name: Barn Owl
keywords.definition: A pale owl with a white heart-shaped face, dark eyes and soft gold and gray wings. It looks like a friendly ghost at dusk.
keywords.when_to_use: Use for gentle spooky night scenes, old barns and fairy tale moods. Say barn owl to get the heart-shaped face.
keywords.prompt_example: "barn owl in flight over a meadow at dusk, rim light"

keywords.name: Barococo
keywords.definition: Baroque drama plus rococo froth: maximum ornament, zero restraint.
keywords.when_to_use: Use when opulence should be turned past tasteful on purpose.
keywords.prompt_example: "palace hall, barococo style, gold everything"

keywords.name: Baroque
keywords.definition: Seventeenth-century drama: deep shadow, rich fabric, motion and emotion at full volume.
keywords.when_to_use: Use for theatrical portraits and opulent scenes with serious lighting.
keywords.prompt_example: "banquet scene, baroque painting, dramatic light"

keywords.name: Batik
keywords.definition: Cloth decorated with a wax-resist method: wax blocks the dye in some places, leaving the pattern behind. Famous in Indonesia, especially Java, often with fine crackle lines where the wax broke.
keywords.when_to_use: Use for flowing textile patterns, fabric backgrounds and clothing. Mention colors and motifs, like flowers, birds or waves, to guide it.
keywords.prompt_example: "batik fabric with birds and vines, indigo and brown"

keywords.name: Bauhaus
keywords.definition: Early 1900s German modern style built from simple boxes, flat roofs, big windows and no decoration. Often white walls with pops of red, yellow and blue.
keywords.when_to_use: Use for clean, honest buildings and graphic, geometric scenes. It is very plain on purpose, so add color or people if it feels empty.
keywords.prompt_example: "white Bauhaus apartment block, red door, sunny morning"

keywords.name: Bauhaus Graphic Design
keywords.definition: The 1920s German design school look: circles, squares and triangles in red, yellow, blue and black, strong grids and clean sans-serif lettering.
keywords.when_to_use: Use for posters, logos and layouts that should feel smart, modern and built with a ruler.
keywords.prompt_example: "exhibition poster of a cat made of circles and triangles, bauhaus graphic design, red yellow blue"

keywords.name: Beadwork
keywords.definition: Designs made from tiny glass beads sewn or strung together, sparkling in bright rows and patterns.
keywords.when_to_use: Use for jewelry, bags, clothing details and bright patterned art. Many cultures have their own beadwork traditions, so name one if you can.
keywords.prompt_example: "beadwork pouch with a floral pattern, colorful glass beads, close-up"

keywords.name: Beatrix Potter
keywords.definition: (1866-1943) English author and illustrator of Peter Rabbit. Small, gentle watercolors of animals in tiny coats, with real-looking fur and quiet country gardens.
keywords.when_to_use: Use for sweet children's book animals and cozy garden scenes. It works best small and simple, not for big epic scenes.
keywords.prompt_example: "hedgehog in an apron hanging laundry in a cottage garden, in the style of Beatrix Potter"

keywords.name: Before and After
keywords.definition: One frame split in two, or two moments side by side, showing how something has changed. A bare plot then a full garden, a messy room then a tidy one.
keywords.when_to_use: Use to show transformation, growth or the passing of time. Say 'split screen' or 'side by side' clearly, or the model may only show one side.
keywords.prompt_example: "before and after, split screen, empty lot and blooming community garden"

keywords.name: Before and After Slider
keywords.definition: Two versions of the same picture sit on top of each other, with a line and handle you drag sideways to uncover one or the other.
keywords.when_to_use: Use it to show a change, like a photo edit, a makeover or a redesign. It needs two pictures lined up exactly, or the effect falls apart.
keywords.prompt_example: "Build a before and after image slider: a grey 'before' photo and a colourful 'after' photo with a draggable divider handle in the middle."

keywords.name: Ben-Day Dots
keywords.definition: Tiny evenly spaced colored dots used in old printed comics to make pinks, skies and skin tones. Up close they make a bold, poppy pattern.
keywords.when_to_use: Use for retro pop art and classic comic looks. Ask for 'large visible dots' if you want them to really show.
keywords.prompt_example: "woman crying on a phone, ben-day dots, bold black outlines, pop art"

keywords.name: Bento Grid Layout
keywords.definition: Content sits in a grid of rounded boxes of different sizes, like the little compartments in a bento lunch box. Soft spacing and gentle contrast make it easy to scan.
keywords.when_to_use: Use for product feature pages, portfolios and personal link pages. If every box shouts at once it feels crowded, so keep a few big and the rest small.
keywords.prompt_example: "feature page for a fitness app, bento grid layout, six rounded tiles of different sizes"

keywords.name: Billy Baldwin
keywords.definition: American decorator (1903-1983) known for glossy chocolate brown walls, tall brass bookshelves, simple cotton slipcovers and comfy slipper chairs. Classy but never fussy.
keywords.when_to_use: Use for sophisticated, cozy apartments with a 1960s New York feel. Leans dark and warm, so it suits evening scenes.
keywords.prompt_example: "library with brown lacquered walls and brass bookshelves, Billy Baldwin style, lamplight"

keywords.name: Binary Art
keywords.definition: Imagery built from 1s and 0s: code as texture, data as portrait.
keywords.when_to_use: Use for tech subjects and digital-identity themes.
keywords.prompt_example: "face formed from binary code, binary art"

keywords.name: Bioluminescence
keywords.definition: Natural glow from living things, like glowing mushrooms, plankton, or deep-sea creatures. Magical and otherworldly.
keywords.when_to_use: Use for fantasy scenes, night nature, and anything that should feel softly magical without being cartoonish.
keywords.prompt_example: "midnight forest floor, bioluminescent mushrooms"

keywords.name: Biomechanical Art
keywords.definition: Flesh fused with machine in intricate detail; Giger-adjacent dark elegance.
keywords.when_to_use: Use for dark sci-fi characters and ornate machine-organism designs.
keywords.prompt_example: "biomechanical portrait, intricate detail"

keywords.name: Biomorphic Art
keywords.definition: Abstract forms echoing living shapes: amoebas, kidneys, curves that feel grown not drawn.
keywords.when_to_use: Use for soft organic abstraction and mid-century-flavored forms.
keywords.prompt_example: "biomorphic abstract shapes, matisse cutout energy"

keywords.name: Biopunk Rococo
keywords.definition: Ornate 18th-century curls and gilding grown from living tissue, vines, and organic machinery. Lavish and unsettling in the best way.
keywords.when_to_use: Use for high-concept fantasy, album art, and scenes where beauty should feel slightly alive.
keywords.prompt_example: "biopunk rococo throne room, living gold filigree"

keywords.name: Bird's-Eye View
keywords.definition: Looking straight down from above.
keywords.when_to_use: Use for patterns, maps, choreography, or a calm god's-eye distance.
keywords.prompt_example: "bird's-eye view of the dancers forming a circle"

keywords.name: Blank Canvas Minimal UI
keywords.definition: An almost empty, edge-to-edge white screen where the type does all the work. Black is the only filled color, buttons are pill-shaped (long rounded capsules), and there is barely any decoration.
keywords.when_to_use: Use for focused tools, writing apps and developer products where the content matters most. Can feel cold or unfinished for brands that need warmth.
keywords.prompt_example: "coding helper app screen, blank canvas minimal ui, pure white, black pill buttons"

keywords.name: Bleach Bypass
keywords.definition: Desaturated, high-contrast silvery look from skipping the bleach step; war-film grit.
keywords.when_to_use: Use for harsh memories, conflict, and drained worlds.
keywords.prompt_example: "trench sequence, bleach bypass grade"

keywords.name: Blue and White Porcelain
keywords.definition: Smooth white porcelain painted with cobalt blue dragons, flowers and landscapes. First perfected in China and loved worldwide.
keywords.when_to_use: Use for elegant vases, tea sets and patterned backgrounds. One of the most recognizable ceramic looks there is.
keywords.prompt_example: "blue and white porcelain ginger jar with peonies, soft studio light"

keywords.name: Blueprint
keywords.definition: Crisp white lines on deep blue paper, like an old building plan or machine drawing. Measurements, arrows and grid lines make anything look engineered.
keywords.when_to_use: Use to make a design, invention or dream house feel planned and real. Works best for objects and buildings, less well for faces.
keywords.prompt_example: "blueprint of a treehouse with rope ladder, white lines on blue"

keywords.name: Blueprint to Reality
keywords.definition: A crisp blueprint where white lines draw themselves over a blue grid and measurements snap into place, then the flat drawing rises off the page and fills with brick, glass, wood and daylight to become the real thing.
keywords.when_to_use: Perfect for architecture, real estate, product design and how-it's-made stories. The draw-on part takes time, so it is not ideal for very short clips.
keywords.prompt_example: "15-second real estate reveal, blueprint to reality animation, white lines drawing a house on blue grid, then becoming a sunlit home"

keywords.name: Boardroom
keywords.definition: A formal meeting room with a long polished table, rows of chairs, a big screen and often a city view behind glass walls.
keywords.when_to_use: Use for leadership, big decisions and serious business moments. Add people and a mood, or it can feel cold and empty.
keywords.prompt_example: "executives around a long boardroom table at dusk, city lights through glass walls"

keywords.name: Boho Chic
keywords.definition: Free-spirited, layered style: flowing maxi skirts, fringed suede, embroidered tops, wide-brim hats and stacks of jewelry. Earthy, relaxed and a little wild.
keywords.when_to_use: Use for festivals, desert road trips and sunny outdoor portraits. Pairs well with warm, dusty light and natural textures.
keywords.prompt_example: "woman in boho chic outfit, fringed suede vest and maxi skirt, desert at sunset"

keywords.name: Boho Interior
keywords.definition: Free-spirited rooms with rattan, woven rugs, macrame, floor cushions, trailing plants and warm earthy colors.
keywords.when_to_use: Use for relaxed, sunny, traveler-style spaces. Easy to overdo, so pick a few hero pieces.
keywords.prompt_example: "boho interior bedroom, macrame wall hanging, rattan peacock chair, plants"

keywords.name: Bokeh
keywords.definition: Out-of-focus highlights rendered as soft glowing discs; blur as decoration.
keywords.when_to_use: Use for romantic night scenes and gentle backgrounds full of city lights.
keywords.prompt_example: "night portrait, street lamps as soft bokeh"

keywords.name: Bold Web Design
keywords.definition: Huge, heavy headlines in Archivo Black, strong contrast and big confident blocks of color that fill the screen.
keywords.when_to_use: Use for launches, sports, drinks and campaigns that need to grab attention fast. Hard on the eyes for long reading or calm brands.
keywords.prompt_example: "launch page for a cat energy drink, bold web design, giant black headline on yellow"

keywords.name: Bonsai
keywords.definition: A tree kept small in a shallow pot, trimmed and shaped to look old and windswept. Quiet, patient and full of character.
keywords.when_to_use: Use for calm, minimal scenes and Japanese-inspired still lifes. It shines on a plain background where its shape can breathe.
keywords.prompt_example: "twisted juniper bonsai on a wooden stand, soft morning light"

keywords.name: Botanical Art
keywords.definition: Precise, loving plant illustration in the tradition of scientific field guides.
keywords.when_to_use: Use for elegant plant studies, wall art, and herbarium moods.
keywords.prompt_example: "botanical art plate, foxglove study"

keywords.name: Botanical Plate
keywords.definition: An old scientific page showing one plant from root to flower, drawn with care and labeled in small neat writing. Usually soft colors on cream paper, with a few cut-open details on the side.
keywords.when_to_use: Use for elegant prints, wall art and anything that should feel studied and calm. Labels may come out as pretend Latin, which often looks charming anyway.
keywords.prompt_example: "botanical plate of a wild rose, hand-colored engraving, cream paper"

keywords.name: Bottom Sheet
keywords.definition: A panel that slides up from the bottom of a phone screen with a small grab handle on top. You can drag it down to close it.
keywords.when_to_use: Use it on mobile for quick choices like sharing or sorting, right where a thumb can reach. It is made for phones and feels odd on a wide desktop screen.
keywords.prompt_example: "Add a bottom sheet to my mobile app that slides up when I tap Share, shows three options and closes when I drag its handle down"

keywords.name: Box Braids
keywords.definition: Long braids sectioned into neat squares at the scalp, a protective style with deep roots in African and Black hair traditions. Worn down, up, or gathered into a high bun.
keywords.when_to_use: Use for accurate, respectful portraits and characters with braided hair. Add length or details, like 'waist-length' or 'with gold cuffs.'
keywords.prompt_example: "portrait of a woman with long box braids, gold hair cuffs, studio light"

keywords.name: Brass
keywords.definition: A warm, golden-yellow metal that shines softly and darkens with age. Think old instruments, lamps and door knobs.
keywords.when_to_use: Use for vintage interiors, steampunk details and cozy warm glow. It is warmer and more lived-in than gold.
keywords.prompt_example: "old brass telescope on a desk, warm lamp light, maps behind"

keywords.name: Breadcrumbs
keywords.definition: A trail of links at the top of a page, like Home > Library > Lighting, showing the path you took to get here. The last one is where you are, and clicking any earlier one takes you back there.
keywords.when_to_use: Use it on sites with several levels, like libraries, shops or help centres. It adds little on a flat site with only a few pages.
keywords.prompt_example: "Add a breadcrumb trail above the page title that grows as I go deeper, highlights the current page and trims back when I click an earlier crumb."

keywords.name: Breakdancing Freeze
keywords.definition: A breakdancer stopped mid-move, balanced on one hand or their head with legs locked in the air. Bold, strong and surprising.
keywords.when_to_use: Use for street culture, high-energy scenes and urban portraits. Balances can look awkward, so a low angle helps sell the power.
keywords.prompt_example: "breakdancer in a freeze on one hand, city street at night, low angle"

keywords.name: Brick Toy Stop Motion
keywords.definition: A stop motion film of glossy toy bricks on a wooden desk, shot up close: pieces fly in on arcs and click into place, little figures hold big poses, and household objects become mountains and moons.
keywords.when_to_use: Great for playful product stories, kids' content and building-themed explainers. It should look like a generic toy, never a real branded set.
keywords.prompt_example: "15-second build reel, brick toy stop motion, glossy toy bricks flying in and clicking together on a wooden desk, macro close up"

keywords.name: Broad-Shouldered
keywords.definition: Wide shoulders and a sturdy upper body, the kind of frame that fills a doorway or a jacket. Reads strong, solid and dependable.
keywords.when_to_use: Use for builders, rowers, swimmers or anyone with a strong frame, of any gender. Helps break the AI habit of giving everyone the same narrow shape.
keywords.prompt_example: "broad-shouldered woman carrying lumber on a building site, golden hour"

keywords.name: Brushed Metal
keywords.definition: Metal with a fine, satiny grain instead of a mirror shine. Modern, clean, industrial.
keywords.when_to_use: Use for product shots, tech, and modern interiors when chrome feels too flashy.
keywords.prompt_example: "brushed metal coffee machine, morning kitchen light"

keywords.name: Brutalist Botanical
keywords.definition: Massive raw concrete forms softened by wild, overflowing plant life. Cold architecture, warm nature, perfect tension.
keywords.when_to_use: Use for architecture content, book covers, and solarpunk-adjacent worldbuilding.
keywords.prompt_example: "brutalist botanical tower, concrete and hanging gardens"

keywords.name: Brutalist Web Design
keywords.definition: A raw, deliberately rough site inspired by bare concrete buildings: plain boxes, harsh lines, odd layouts and almost no decoration, set in Darker Grotesque.
keywords.when_to_use: Use for art projects, zines, studios and brands that want to look rebellious and honest. Can confuse visitors who expect a normal, friendly shop.
keywords.prompt_example: "website for an underground record label, brutalist web design, plain grey boxes, harsh black text"

keywords.name: Bubble Bujo
keywords.definition: Bullet-journal bubble lettering: rounded, bold, friendly letterforms and sticker-like flourishes.
keywords.when_to_use: Use for hand-lettered headers, planners, and cheerful typographic art.
keywords.prompt_example: "title page lettering, bubble bujo style"

keywords.name: Bubble Goth
keywords.definition: Goth cheerfulness: black-and-neon palettes, glossy textures, cute darkness invented by pop artist Kerli.
keywords.when_to_use: Use when gothic subjects need bounce, shine, and a bit of bubblegum.
keywords.prompt_example: "portrait, bubble goth aesthetic, pastel and black"

keywords.name: Burgundy
keywords.definition: A deep, rich red with a hint of purple, like red wine in a glass.
keywords.when_to_use: Use for elegant, romantic and moody scenes, from velvet chairs to winter fashion. In dark scenes it can read as black, so give it light.
keywords.prompt_example: "burgundy velvet gown in a candlelit hall"

keywords.name: Cabochon
keywords.definition: A gemstone polished into a smooth, rounded dome with no sharp facets. It glows from within instead of sparkling.
keywords.when_to_use: Use for vintage, medieval and fantasy jewelry, especially with moonstone, turquoise or garnet. Great for rings that look old and treasured.
keywords.prompt_example: "antique gold ring with a deep red garnet cabochon, candlelit wooden table"

keywords.name: Cafe Web Design
keywords.definition: A cozy coffee shop feel with warm browns and creams, soft rounded Poppins type and clean, relaxed layouts.
keywords.when_to_use: Use for cafes, bakeries, tea shops and small lifestyle brands. A bit too gentle for tech or high-energy products.
keywords.prompt_example: "menu website for a neighborhood bakery, cafe web design, warm cream and coffee brown"

keywords.name: Call to Adventure
keywords.definition: The moment just before a journey begins: a letter arrives, a door creaks open, a strange light appears on the hill. The character hasn't moved yet, but everything is about to change.
keywords.when_to_use: Use when you want a picture full of possibility and a story waiting to happen. Show the character small and the doorway or path big.
keywords.prompt_example: "call to adventure, girl at farmhouse gate, glowing path into the woods"

keywords.name: Calm Before the Storm
keywords.definition: A peaceful scene with a hint of trouble on the way: a picnic under darkening clouds, a sleeping town as an army gathers on the hill.
keywords.when_to_use: Use to build tension while things still look quiet. Put the calm thing up close and the coming danger small in the distance.
keywords.prompt_example: "calm before the storm, kids flying kites, huge black thunderhead behind"

keywords.name: Camera Roll
keywords.definition: The camera rotates around its own lens, tipping the whole picture over.
keywords.when_to_use: Use for dizziness, dream logic, or a world turning upside down.
keywords.prompt_example: "the camera rolls a full turn as it pushes toward her"

keywords.name: Camera Roll World Flip
keywords.definition: The camera rolls a full turn around its lens, and when the horizon comes back level, we are somewhere new.
keywords.when_to_use: Use it for surreal reveals or a world turning over. Spinning can make some viewers dizzy, so use it once, not in every scene.
keywords.prompt_example: "the camera pushes in and rolls a full turn, the horizon going upside down; as it levels out we are in an underwater city"

keywords.name: Candid
keywords.definition: Unposed, caught-in-the-moment photography. Real expressions, imperfect framing, honest life.
keywords.when_to_use: Use when posed images feel stiff. Perfect for storytelling and documentary feels.
keywords.prompt_example: "candid photo of friends laughing at a kitchen table"

keywords.name: Candle Making
keywords.definition: Melted wax being poured into jars, with wicks held straight and dried flowers on the side. Warm, homey and a little bit magical.
keywords.when_to_use: Use for cozy workshop scenes and slow, satisfying pouring shots. It works for video too, as a gentle pour.
keywords.prompt_example: "pouring cream wax into amber jars, dried lavender on the table"

keywords.name: Candlelight
keywords.definition: Warm, flickering, intimate light from a small flame. Everything feels closer and quieter.
keywords.when_to_use: Use for cozy, romantic, or historical scenes. It naturally darkens the edges of the frame.
keywords.prompt_example: "handwritten letter on a desk, candlelight"

keywords.name: Captain Nemo
keywords.definition: The mysterious captain from the original 1870 novel, who roams the oceans in his submarine, the Nautilus. Picture a proud, bearded man playing an organ in a grand salon with a huge window onto the sea. Describe the book version.
keywords.when_to_use: Use for steampunk-flavored undersea adventure and brass-and-velvet interiors. Ask for 'vintage book engraving' for the classic look.
keywords.prompt_example: "captain nemo in the nautilus salon, giant round window, glowing jellyfish outside, vintage book engraving"

keywords.name: Car Reveal One-Take
keywords.definition: One unbroken shot that starts from above, drops to the wheel, glides to the lamp, circles to the back and rises to a big wide view.
keywords.when_to_use: Use it for a whole car or product spot with no cuts. The tested version runs about 20 seconds; for shorter clips, cut it down to two or three steps.
keywords.prompt_example: "one unbroken reveal: top-down over a silver car, descend to the front wheel, glide to the headlamp, orbit to the back, rise to a hero wide"

keywords.name: Caravaggio
keywords.definition: (1571-1610) Italian painter of dramatic scenes where figures burst out of pitch-black backgrounds in a harsh beam of light. Real, gritty faces and theatrical moments.
keywords.when_to_use: Use for intense, dramatic scenes and moody portraits. It is very dark, so it is wrong for bright or cheerful images.
keywords.prompt_example: "young musician with a lute lit by a single beam, in the style of Caravaggio"

keywords.name: Card Flip
keywords.definition: A card that turns over like a playing card when you click or hover, showing more information on its back. It flips back to the front when you are done.
keywords.when_to_use: Use it to tuck a short description or a button behind a picture, like on flashcards or product tiles. Keep the back short, since flipping hides the front.
keywords.prompt_example: "Make these keyword cards flip over in 3D when clicked to show a short description and a Use it button on the back, then flip back on a second click."

keywords.name: Caricature
keywords.definition: Exaggerated portraiture that amplifies a subject's most recognizable features with affection.
keywords.when_to_use: Use for humorous portraits and editorial cartooning.
keywords.prompt_example: "caricature of a chef, exaggerated features"

keywords.name: Cartoon
keywords.definition: Simplified, exaggerated character rendering with bold outlines and expressive features.
keywords.when_to_use: Use for friendly characters, mascots, and anything meant to make people smile fast.
keywords.prompt_example: "cartoon dog chef, simple shapes"

keywords.name: Cassette Tape
keywords.definition: A small plastic tape case with two little reels and a handwritten label. Pure mixtape nostalgia.
keywords.when_to_use: Use for retro, 80s and 90s scenes, flat lays and nostalgic music moments. Handwritten labels may come out scrambled.
keywords.prompt_example: "cassette tape with a handwritten label on a desk, retro colors, flat lay"

keywords.name: Cave Painting
keywords.definition: The oldest art we know: animals drawn in red ochre and charcoal on rough rock walls, stencilled handprints, and flickering firelight bringing it all to life.
keywords.when_to_use: Use for ancient, primal moods, origin stories and any subject that should feel timeless and deeply human.
keywords.prompt_example: "herd of horses running across a rock wall, cave painting, red ochre and charcoal"

keywords.name: Cel-Shaded Render
keywords.definition: 3D shapes painted with flat blocks of color and bold outlines, so they look like a cartoon or anime drawing.
keywords.when_to_use: Use when you want 3D depth with a hand-drawn feel, great for characters and game scenes. Fine painterly detail gets flattened.
keywords.prompt_example: "fox adventurer on a cliff, cel-shaded render, bright sky"

keywords.name: Cel Shading
keywords.definition: Flat blocks of color with crisp, hard-edged shadows, like a frame from a hand-painted cartoon. No soft blending, just clean light and dark.
keywords.when_to_use: Use when you want a clean animated look for characters, games or scenes. It flattens fine texture, so skip it if you want painterly detail.
keywords.prompt_example: "fox courier on a bicycle, cel shading, bright afternoon"

keywords.name: Celadon
keywords.definition: A soft jade-green glaze, glassy and pale, used on Chinese and Korean pottery for over a thousand years.
keywords.when_to_use: Use for serene, elegant pottery and calm still lifes. The green is gentle, so avoid busy colors around it.
keywords.prompt_example: "celadon tea bowl on a linen cloth, soft window light"

keywords.name: Chaise Longue
keywords.definition: A long upholstered chair you can stretch your legs out on, with one raised end like a half sofa.
keywords.when_to_use: Use for lazy, elegant lounging scenes and dreamy portraits. Great for a reclining pose.
keywords.prompt_example: "woman reading on a velvet chaise longue by a tall window"

keywords.name: Chalkboard Lecture
keywords.definition: A teacher at a big chalkboard covered in dusty white equations, diagrams and arrows, with chalk smudges and a classroom full of attention.
keywords.when_to_use: Use for teaching, science and math moments, and the classic "genius at work" scene. Equations will look real from afar but won't make sense up close.
keywords.prompt_example: "professor writing equations at a chalkboard lecture, chalk dust in a sunbeam"

keywords.name: Character Sheet
keywords.definition: One character shown several times on a single page, usually front, side and back, sometimes with faces and outfits too.
keywords.when_to_use: Use when you want to design a character and keep them consistent later. Small details can change between poses, so check each one.
keywords.prompt_example: "character sheet of a young witch, front side and back views"

keywords.name: Charcoal and Gold Leaf
keywords.definition: Smudgy black charcoal drawing with shining patches of real-looking gold leaf. Moody and precious at once.
keywords.when_to_use: Use for elegant portraits, animals and sacred-feeling art. Gold can look flat yellow, so ask for 'metallic gold leaf' to keep the shine.
keywords.prompt_example: "charcoal sketch of a horse with metallic gold leaf mane"

keywords.name: Charcoal Sketch
keywords.definition: Loose, smudgy black drawing with rough strokes and soft shading. Raw and expressive.
keywords.when_to_use: Use for emotion, movement studies, and dramatic portraits where polish would kill the feeling.
keywords.prompt_example: "charcoal sketch of a dancer mid-leap"

keywords.name: Charcuterie Board
keywords.definition: A wooden board piled with cured meats, cheeses, grapes, crackers, nuts and honey. Generous, colorful and made for sharing.
keywords.when_to_use: Use for party spreads, cozy gatherings and overhead food shots. It looks best from straight above.
keywords.prompt_example: "charcuterie board with figs, brie and honeycomb, overhead shot"

keywords.name: Chartreuse
keywords.definition: A sharp yellow-green, halfway between lime and lemon, named after a French herbal liqueur. Bold, zesty and a little bit odd.
keywords.when_to_use: Use when you want a fresh, eye-grabbing color that feels fashion-forward. Too much can look sickly, so use it as an accent.
keywords.prompt_example: "model in a chartreuse coat against a lilac wall"

keywords.name: Chase One-Take
keywords.definition: A runner chased down a wet street at night, the camera running ahead, then swinging round to follow.
keywords.when_to_use: Use it for chases and pursuits. Keep it to one runner and a few simple chasers, because crowds tend to fall apart in a long take.
keywords.prompt_example: "the camera leads a runner down a wet night street, then swings round to follow as police close in"

keywords.name: Cheese Pull
keywords.definition: Long, stretchy strings of melted cheese pulling apart as a slice or sandwich is lifted. Gooey and impossible to ignore.
keywords.when_to_use: Use for pizza, grilled cheese and lasagna shots that need instant appetite. Strings can come out looking like rubber, so add words like melted and gooey.
keywords.prompt_example: "lifting a slice of pizza, long cheese pull, warm light"

keywords.name: Chesterfield Sofa
keywords.definition: A deep-buttoned leather sofa with rolled arms the same height as the back. Classic gentleman's club furniture.
keywords.when_to_use: Use for libraries, studies and cozy old-world rooms. Brown leather is the classic, but velvet versions look great too.
keywords.prompt_example: "oxblood leather Chesterfield sofa in a wood-paneled study, lamplight"

keywords.name: Chevron
keywords.definition: Bold zigzag stripes stacked into rows of V shapes. Energetic and graphic, like a lightning bolt on repeat.
keywords.when_to_use: Use for rugs, wallpaper, sportswear and playful backgrounds. Simple and strong, but it can look dated if the colors are loud.
keywords.prompt_example: "living room with a mustard and white chevron rug"

keywords.name: Chiaroscuro
keywords.definition: An old painting term for dramatic light against deep shadow. Think candlelit faces in dark rooms, Rembrandt style.
keywords.when_to_use: Use for moody portraits, mystery, and drama. Not for cheerful scenes; it will darken everything.
keywords.prompt_example: "violinist in an empty theatre, chiaroscuro"

keywords.name: Chibi
keywords.definition: A tiny, super-cute character style with a big head, a small body and stubby limbs. Usually only two or three heads tall.
keywords.when_to_use: Use for stickers, mascots and funny reaction art. It's not built for drama or realistic proportions.
keywords.prompt_example: "chibi knight hugging a giant strawberry, pastel colors"

keywords.name: Chic Modernist
keywords.definition: Clean modernist design with fashion polish: neutral palettes, sculptural furniture, quiet money.
keywords.when_to_use: Use for sophisticated interiors and minimalist lifestyle scenes.
keywords.prompt_example: "living room, chic modernist interior"

keywords.name: Child's Drawing
keywords.definition: Deliberately naive crayon-and-marker rendering: wobbly lines, wrong proportions, pure joy.
keywords.when_to_use: Use for innocence, humor, or emotionally disarming contrast.
keywords.prompt_example: "family portrait, child's crayon drawing"

keywords.name: Chinese Ink Wash Painting
keywords.definition: Black ink brushed onto paper or silk, from deep strokes to pale grey washes. Misty mountains, bamboo, and lots of quiet empty space.
keywords.when_to_use: Use for calm, poetic landscapes and nature studies. It's mostly black and grey, so add 'light color' if you want a touch of tint.
keywords.prompt_example: "Chinese ink wash painting of mountains in mist, a small boat"

keywords.name: Chinese Shadow Puppetry
keywords.definition: Translucent leather puppets lit from behind a paper screen: lace-like cut patterns, glowing color, jointed limbs moved on rods and the warm flicker of an oil lamp.
keywords.when_to_use: Use for folk tales, theatrical storytelling and scenes that should feel handmade, warm and ancient.
keywords.prompt_example: "warrior and dragon behind a glowing paper screen, chinese shadow puppetry, translucent leather"

keywords.name: Chiptune
keywords.definition: 8-bit game aesthetics: pixel color palettes, sprite logic, console-era charm.
keywords.when_to_use: Use for retro-game scenes and nostalgic pixel compositions.
keywords.prompt_example: "pixel city at night, chiptune aesthetic"

keywords.name: Christian Dior
keywords.definition: French designer Christian Dior (1905-1957) launched the 1947 New Look: soft shoulders, tiny cinched waists and huge full skirts that brought romance back after the war.
keywords.when_to_use: Use for 1950s couture glamour and dramatic ball gowns. Great with fashion photo terms for a vintage magazine feel.
keywords.prompt_example: "evening gown in the style of christian dior, full tulle skirt, cinched waist, 1950s couture salon"

keywords.name: Chromatic Aberration
keywords.definition: Thin red and blue color fringes along the edges of things, like an old or cheap lens splitting the light. It gives a slightly glitchy, retro camera feel.
keywords.when_to_use: Use for edgy, retro, dreamlike or sci-fi looks. A little goes far; too much just looks blurry.
keywords.prompt_example: "skateboarder at dusk, chromatic aberration, grainy film"

keywords.name: Chrome
keywords.definition: Super shiny, mirror-like silver metal that reflects everything around it in curved, warped shapes.
keywords.when_to_use: Use for retro cars, futuristic designs and bold, glossy objects. Reflections can get messy, so a clean setting helps.
keywords.prompt_example: "chrome sphere on a checkered floor reflecting neon lights"

keywords.name: City Pop
keywords.definition: 1980s Japanese city-pop album art: airbrushed sunsets, convertibles, neon skylines, easy glamour.
keywords.when_to_use: Use for retro-cool urban scenes with a soundtrack you can almost hear.
keywords.prompt_example: "night drive, city pop album art, 1984"

keywords.name: Cityscape
keywords.definition: A wide view of a city: rooftops, lights, layers of buildings stacked to the horizon.
keywords.when_to_use: Use for establishing shots, urban energy, and scale.
keywords.prompt_example: "rainy cityscape at blue hour, glowing windows"

keywords.name: Claude Monet
keywords.definition: (1840-1926) French Impressionist who painted light more than things: water lilies, haystacks and gardens in soft, dabbed brushstrokes and shimmering color.
keywords.when_to_use: Use for dreamy gardens, ponds and sunlit landscapes. Details melt away, so it is not for sharp faces or text.
keywords.prompt_example: "water lily pond with a small wooden bridge, in the style of Claude Monet"

keywords.name: Clay Render
keywords.definition: Everything is shown in plain, smooth, matte clay, usually one soft gray or white. Shapes and shadows do all the talking.
keywords.when_to_use: Use to show off form and lighting without color getting in the way. Not the pick if you need color or fine surface detail.
keywords.prompt_example: "teapot on a windowsill, clay render, soft studio light"

keywords.name: Claymation
keywords.definition: The look of hand-molded clay characters, with fingerprint softness and stop-motion charm.
keywords.when_to_use: Use for friendly characters and nostalgic, handmade animation vibes.
keywords.prompt_example: "claymation robot watering a tiny garden"

keywords.name: Claymorphism UI
keywords.definition: Soft, puffy buttons and cards that look shaped from colorful modeling clay, with rounded edges and gentle shadows.
keywords.when_to_use: Use for kids' apps, games, friendly money apps and playful product pages. Can look toy-like for serious or luxury brands.
keywords.prompt_example: "savings app home screen, claymorphism ui, puffy pastel buttons, soft shadows"

keywords.name: Clean Web Design
keywords.definition: Lots of empty space, easy-to-read Roboto and Poppins type and only a few colors, so nothing clutters the page.
keywords.when_to_use: A safe choice for almost any business, service or portfolio. It can feel plain if your brand needs a strong personality.
keywords.prompt_example: "website for a dog walking service, clean web design, white space, one green accent"

keywords.name: Close-Up
keywords.definition: The face fills the frame; every flicker of feeling becomes the story.
keywords.when_to_use: Use for emotional beats, reactions, and decisive moments.
keywords.prompt_example: "close-up on his eyes as the verdict is read"

keywords.name: Cloud Chamber
keywords.definition: A dark, misty box where invisible particles from space leave thin, wispy trails that appear and fade, like tiny shooting stars.
keywords.when_to_use: Use for mysterious science scenes and abstract, starry textures. It is a niche idea, so describe the wispy trails in your prompt too.
keywords.prompt_example: "cloud chamber, thin glowing particle trails in mist, black background"

keywords.name: Cloudscape
keywords.definition: The sky as the whole scene: towering clouds, light beams, endless space.
keywords.when_to_use: Use for freedom, spirituality, and scale. Beautiful backdrop for flying subjects.
keywords.prompt_example: "golden cloudscape at sunset, birds crossing"

keywords.name: Cobalt Blue
keywords.definition: A strong, bright, pure blue, deeper than sky blue and brighter than navy. Think of blue glass bottles and painted pottery.
keywords.when_to_use: Use when you want a bold blue that feels clean and confident. It can overpower a scene, so use it for one star element.
keywords.prompt_example: "cobalt blue door on a whitewashed wall, bright sun"

keywords.name: Coco Chanel
keywords.definition: French designer Coco Chanel (1883-1971) freed women from corsets with comfortable jersey, collarless tweed suits trimmed in braid, the little black dress and long ropes of pearls.
keywords.when_to_use: Use for chic, timeless Parisian elegance in black, white and cream. It points to her classic look, so describe the outfit if you want something modern.
keywords.prompt_example: "woman in a cream tweed suit with braid trim and pearls, in the style of coco chanel, paris apartment"

keywords.name: Collage and Paint
keywords.definition: Torn paper, old photos and magazine bits glued down, then painted over with bold brushstrokes.
keywords.when_to_use: Use for artsy, layered and expressive images with a scrapbook feel. It is busy by nature, so keep one clear subject.
keywords.prompt_example: "collage and paint portrait, torn maps, bold red brushstrokes"

keywords.name: Collage Explainer
keywords.definition: The investigative news-video look: real clippings, photos and charts laid on a desk, with red lines and highlighter drawn on as the camera moves from clue to clue.
keywords.when_to_use: Use for arguments built on evidence, like news stories, history and how-it-really-happened breakdowns.
keywords.prompt_example: "newspaper clippings and a chart on a desk, red marker circles the key number, collage explainer"

keywords.name: Colorful Web Design
keywords.definition: Bright, high-contrast colors and gradients (smooth blends from one color to another) across buttons, cards and backgrounds.
keywords.when_to_use: Use for creative apps, events, kids' brands and anything that should feel fun and memorable. Easy to overdo, so keep text areas calm and readable.
keywords.prompt_example: "summer festival website, colorful web design, rainbow gradients, bright buttons"

keywords.name: Colour Match Cut
keywords.definition: The frame fills with one colour, then cuts to something else of the same colour.
keywords.when_to_use: Use to link two unrelated scenes in a satisfying way.
keywords.prompt_example: "the frame fills with red paint, then cuts to a red umbrella in the rain"

keywords.name: Colour Separation
keywords.definition: Your subject's colour stands apart from the colours around it.
keywords.when_to_use: Use it to make the subject pop without any lighting tricks. Warm against cool is the easiest pair to ask for.
keywords.prompt_example: "colour separation, a robot in warm orange tones against a cool blue alley"

keywords.name: Comic Art
keywords.definition: Bold inked panels, dynamic poses, halftone dots and action-ready composition.
keywords.when_to_use: Use for storytelling frames, hero shots, and graphic punch.
keywords.prompt_example: "superhero landing, comic art style"

keywords.name: Comic Strip
keywords.definition: A short row of three or four panels that tells a tiny story, like the funny pages in a Sunday newspaper.
keywords.when_to_use: Use for jokes, quick before-and-after stories and character moments. Ask for fewer panels if the faces start to drift between them.
keywords.prompt_example: "three-panel comic strip of a cat stealing toast, clean ink lines, bright flat colors"

keywords.name: Concert Stage Lights
keywords.definition: Bright beams of colored light cutting through haze above a stage and a crowd. Big, loud energy you can see.
keywords.when_to_use: Use for gigs, festivals and big hero moments. Haze or fog is what makes the beams show, so add it in.
keywords.prompt_example: "rock band on stage, colored concert stage lights through haze, crowd silhouettes"

keywords.name: Concrete Art
keywords.definition: Pure geometric abstraction with no reference to the real world; math made visual.
keywords.when_to_use: Use for clean, rational abstract pieces and modernist design work.
keywords.prompt_example: "geometric abstract, concrete art style"

keywords.name: Condensation Droplets
keywords.definition: Tiny beads of water clinging to the outside of a cold glass or bottle. They make a drink look ice-cold and refreshing.
keywords.when_to_use: Use for cold drinks, iced coffee and summer scenes. Close shots with backlight make the droplets sparkle.
keywords.prompt_example: "iced lemonade glass covered in condensation droplets, sunny patio"

keywords.name: Confetti Burst
keywords.definition: Clicking a button like Submit or Done sends a burst of colourful confetti flying out, spinning, falling and fading away.
keywords.when_to_use: Use it to celebrate a real moment, like finishing sign up or completing a task. Save it for big wins; confetti on every click loses its joy.
keywords.prompt_example: "When I click the Submit button, burst colourful confetti out of it that spins, falls and fades, and turn the button into a green Done."

keywords.name: Contemporary Dance
keywords.definition: Free, flowing movement that mixes reaching, falling and rolling, often barefoot in simple clothes. Expressive and emotional.
keywords.when_to_use: Use for feelings that are hard to say: grief, joy, longing. Keep backgrounds simple so the body tells the story.
keywords.prompt_example: "contemporary dancer mid-leap, loose white clothes, empty studio, window light"

keywords.name: Contemporary Web Design
keywords.definition: Today's tidy modern look: grids of boxes, an optional dark mode, clean Jost type and fast, easy-to-use layouts.
keywords.when_to_use: Use for startups, apps and product sites that want to feel current. Because it is so common, it can blend in with many other sites.
keywords.prompt_example: "homepage for a plant care app, contemporary web design, dark mode, grid of feature boxes"

keywords.name: Conversion Landing Page Design
keywords.definition: A simple, no-distraction page that leads visitors step by step toward one action, like signing up or buying, with clear headlines, reviews and big buttons. Designers call that action a conversion.
keywords.when_to_use: Use for sales pages, sign-up pages and product launches. It is built to sell, so it can feel pushy for a portfolio or story site.
keywords.prompt_example: "sign-up page for an online cooking class, conversion landing page design, one big button, customer reviews"

keywords.name: Copper Patina
keywords.definition: Copper that has turned a soft blue-green over time, with patches of warm brown still showing through. Old, weathered and beautiful.
keywords.when_to_use: Use for aged rooftops, antique objects and fantasy ruins. It adds history to anything it touches.
keywords.prompt_example: "old copper dome with green patina, cloudy sky"

keywords.name: Copperplate Engraving
keywords.definition: An old natural history plate that engraves itself: fine swelling lines cut into copper, the picture builds from outline to shading to cross-hatching, close-up details fly out in numbered circles, and a hand-laid color wash finishes it.
keywords.when_to_use: Great for science, history, nature and vintage brand stories. It is detailed and scholarly, so it can feel dry for casual social posts.
keywords.prompt_example: "20-second nature explainer, copperplate engraving animation, a beetle engraving itself line by line, numbered detail circles flying out"

keywords.name: Coral
keywords.definition: A lively pinkish orange, warm and happy, like a summer sunset or tropical flowers.
keywords.when_to_use: Use for cheerful, beachy and summery images. It can look loud next to other bright colors, so pair it with white, navy or teal.
keywords.prompt_example: "coral beach hut against a turquoise sea"

keywords.name: -core
keywords.definition: Add -core to almost any word and it becomes a whole mood: cottagecore, goblincore, normcore. It tells the AI to build a world of objects, colors and clothing around that one idea.
keywords.when_to_use: Use to turn a single theme into a full aesthetic. Brand-new combos may be too new for the AI to know, so add a few details too.
keywords.prompt_example: "mushroomcore reading nook, moss, soft window light"

keywords.name: Corporate Headshot
keywords.definition: A clean, friendly head and shoulders portrait on a plain or softly blurred background, with even, flattering light and a confident smile.
keywords.when_to_use: Use for team pages, profile pictures and speaker bios. Add an age, outfit and background color so every headshot doesn't look the same.
keywords.prompt_example: "corporate headshot of a woman in a grey blazer, soft grey backdrop, friendly smile"

keywords.name: Corporate Web Design
keywords.definition: A professional, orderly site with structured grids, simple layouts and consistent Open Sans and Poppins type, like you see on big company sites.
keywords.when_to_use: Use for law firms, consultants, finance and companies that sell to other businesses. Can feel stiff and impersonal for creative brands.
keywords.prompt_example: "website for an accounting firm, corporate web design, navy and white, tidy grid"

keywords.name: Cosmic Web Design
keywords.definition: A sci-fi site set in deep space, with dark backgrounds, glowing neon accents, starry depth and the wide, futuristic Audiowide font.
keywords.when_to_use: Use for games, music, astronomy clubs and space-themed launches. Dark pages can be tiring for long reading.
keywords.prompt_example: "launch page for a stargazing app, cosmic web design, deep space background, glowing purple accents"

keywords.name: Cottage Dress
keywords.definition: A soft, romantic dress with puffed sleeves, a fitted bodice and tiny floral print, often in cotton or linen. Feels like picking wildflowers and baking bread.
keywords.when_to_use: Use for countryside, picnic and garden scenes with a gentle, storybook mood. Pairs naturally with baskets, meadows and golden light.
keywords.prompt_example: "girl in a floral cottage dress with puffed sleeves, wildflower meadow"

keywords.name: Count Dracula
keywords.definition: The vampire from the original 1897 novel: a tall old man dressed all in black, with a long white moustache, pointed ears, sharp teeth and hair on his palms. He grows younger as he feeds. Describe the book version, not later film versions.
keywords.when_to_use: Use for gothic horror and creepy castle portraits. Asking for the novel's description gives a stranger, fresher look than the usual caped movie vampire.
keywords.prompt_example: "count dracula from the 1897 novel, old man in black, long white moustache, candlelit castle stair"

keywords.name: Country
keywords.definition: Rural Americana warmth: barns, gingham, golden fields, porch-light hospitality.
keywords.when_to_use: Use for wholesome pastoral scenes and homestead moods.
keywords.prompt_example: "farmhouse kitchen, country style"

keywords.name: Coworking Space
keywords.definition: A shared, stylish workspace where freelancers and small teams rent desks: exposed brick, cozy sofas, phone booths, coffee bar and lots of plants.
keywords.when_to_use: Use for freelance life, networking and creative work scenes. Name a mood like cozy or busy to set the energy.
keywords.prompt_example: "freelancers working in a coworking space with exposed brick and plants, afternoon sun"

keywords.name: Cozy Mystery
keywords.definition: The gentle detective story: a small village, a bookshop or bakery, a cat on the counter and a clue hidden among the teacups. More curious than scary.
keywords.when_to_use: Use for warm, charming scenes with a hint of intrigue. Not the choice for real danger or gore, that is the whole point.
keywords.prompt_example: "lighthouse keeper's cat, cozy mystery, lamplight"

keywords.name: Cracked Porcelain
keywords.definition: Fine, delicate cracks across a smooth ceramic surface, like an antique teacup. Fragile beauty.
keywords.when_to_use: Use for elegance with a hint of sadness or age. Beautiful on faces in surreal art.
keywords.prompt_example: "porcelain doll face with fine cracks, soft light"

keywords.name: Craftsman Bungalow
keywords.definition: A cozy early 1900s American house with a low roof, a deep front porch on thick tapered columns, and lots of natural wood and stone.
