keywords.definition: The bold, high-energy look of action manga made mainly for boys and teens. Spiky hair, determined faces, sharp angles and big dynamic poses.
keywords.when_to_use: Use for battles, sports and hero moments full of movement. It can feel loud, so it's less suited to quiet scenes.
keywords.prompt_example: "shonen style hero leaping across rooftops, speed lines, sunset"

keywords.name: Shoujo Style
keywords.definition: The romantic look of manga made mainly for girls and young women. Huge sparkling eyes, flowing hair, and flowers or sparkles floating behind the characters.
keywords.when_to_use: Use for tender, emotional and romantic moments. Add 'retro' if you want the older, softer look with lots of dotted shading.
keywords.prompt_example: "shoujo style portrait, girl in the rain, roses and sparkles"

keywords.name: Side Drawer
keywords.definition: A menu panel that slides in from the edge of the screen when you click the three line menu icon. The page behind it dims until you close it.
keywords.when_to_use: Use it to tuck away navigation, the list of links to other pages, so the main screen stays clean. People may miss links hidden in it, so keep key actions visible.
keywords.prompt_example: "Make a side drawer menu that slides in from the left when I click the menu icon, dims the page and closes when I click outside it"

keywords.name: Silent Film
keywords.definition: Old black and white movies from before sound: flickering grain, jerky fast motion, big expressive acting and title cards with fancy borders.
keywords.when_to_use: Use for charm, comedy and early 1900s nostalgia. Expect the faces to be exaggerated, because the actors had to tell the story without words.
keywords.prompt_example: "silent film still, baker chasing a runaway cake down a street, flickering grain"

keywords.name: Silent Film Animation
keywords.definition: An old silent comedy as it would look projected: an engraved ink drawing with silver wash, on flickering, wobbling, scratched film in a square frame between velvet curtains, told in wide shots and title cards to piano music. Figures move in a slightly jerky hand-cranked way.
keywords.when_to_use: Charming for vintage-themed stories, comedy shorts and nostalgic brand moments. There is no voice at all, so the story has to read through action and title cards.
keywords.prompt_example: "20-second comedy short, silent film animation, flickering scratched black and white film, a figure chasing a hat, title card between shots"

keywords.name: Silhouette
keywords.definition: The subject reads as pure shape against a brighter background; identity through outline.
keywords.when_to_use: Use for mystery reveals, romantic dusk figures, and iconic frames.
keywords.prompt_example: "silhouette in the doorway, hallway blazing behind"

keywords.name: Silkscreen Poster Animation
keywords.definition: A vintage travel poster printed on camera: one flat ink per pull of the squeegee, stepped color bands instead of smooth blends, thin gaps where layers do not line up, and the key facts printed last. There are no fades at all.
keywords.when_to_use: Great for event posters, travel promos and music announcements. Fine details and smooth blends do not suit it, so keep the art bold and flat.
keywords.prompt_example: "12-second event promo, silkscreen poster animation, flat ink layers printing a mountain poster one pull at a time, date printing last"

keywords.name: Silver Age Comics
keywords.definition: Comic books from the late 1950s to about 1970: cosmic heroes, blocky muscular action, crackling energy dots, big sound-effect lettering and four-color printing.
keywords.when_to_use: Use for explosive action, sci-fi heroes and anything that needs a loud, joyful comic-book bang.
keywords.prompt_example: "hero bursting through a wall, silver age comics, crackling energy dots, KRAKOOM lettering"

keywords.name: Silver Hair
keywords.definition: Shining grey-white hair with a soft metallic glow in the light. It reads as graceful age, or as a bold fashion color on anyone.
keywords.when_to_use: Use for older characters with dignity, or for striking fashion portraits. Add an age word if you want the AI to read it one way.
keywords.prompt_example: "woman in her seventies with silver hair, linen shirt, garden"

keywords.name: Sister Parish
keywords.definition: American decorator (1910-1994) famous for the cozy American country look: patchwork quilts, painted floors, knitted throws, chintz and baskets.
keywords.when_to_use: Use for warm, lived-in country rooms with a homemade touch. Pairs well with quilts and soft daylight.
keywords.prompt_example: "bedroom with patchwork quilt and painted floor, Sister Parish style"

keywords.name: Sizzle
keywords.definition: Food hitting a hot pan or grill with popping oil, little bursts of smoke and browning edges. You can almost hear it.
keywords.when_to_use: Use for cooking action, grills and street food scenes. It works best in video, where the bubbling oil can move.
keywords.prompt_example: "steak sizzling in a cast iron pan, oil spatter, smoky kitchen light"

keywords.name: Skeleton Screen
keywords.definition: Soft grey blocks shaped like the page that show while content is still loading, with a gentle shine sweeping across. They then fade into the real pictures and text.
keywords.when_to_use: Use it so a page feels fast and steady while it waits for data, instead of showing a blank screen. It only helps if the grey shapes match the real layout.
keywords.prompt_example: "While these cards load, show grey placeholder blocks in the same shapes with a soft shimmer sweeping across, then cross-fade into the real cards."

keywords.name: Sketchbook Redraw
keywords.definition: A cream spiral sketchbook where each idea is drawn three times: the caption writes in, a pencil sketch wipes across, then the colored version wipes over it, with a pencil riding along each wipe.
keywords.when_to_use: Great for concept explainers, definitions and kid-friendly lessons. The three-step wipe is busy for a moment at every change, so give each idea a few seconds.
keywords.prompt_example: "30-second explainer, sketchbook redraw animation, pencil sketch wiping across a spiral sketchbook then the color version wiping over it"

keywords.name: Skeuomorphism UI
keywords.definition: Screens that copy real objects, like leather notebooks, wooden shelves and metal knobs, with textures and 3D shading so everything feels touchable.
keywords.when_to_use: Use for music apps, games, calculators and nostalgic tools. Can look old-fashioned and heavy next to modern flat sites.
keywords.prompt_example: "synth app screen, skeuomorphism ui, brushed metal knobs, wooden side panels"

keywords.name: Skim and Barrel Roll
keywords.definition: The camera skims just over the subject while rolling a full circle.
keywords.when_to_use: Use it for a wild drone move nobody would risk this close in real life. It is a lot, so save it for one moment.
keywords.prompt_example: "the camera skims just over a red sports car while barrel-rolling a full 360 degrees, then falls away behind"

keywords.name: Sky Islands
keywords.definition: Floating chunks of land drifting in the clouds, with waterfalls spilling off their edges into the sky.
keywords.when_to_use: Use for epic fantasy views and dreamy adventure scenes. It looks best wide, so pair it with a wide shot.
keywords.prompt_example: "sky islands with waterfalls, tiny village, golden clouds"

keywords.name: Slam Down and Whip
keywords.definition: The camera drops fast from high up to the ground, holds for a beat, then whips sideways.
keywords.when_to_use: Use it to open an action scene with a punch. It is too strong for calm, gentle stories.
keywords.prompt_example: "the camera drops fast from high above to street level, holds a beat, then whips sideways to a dropped helmet"

keywords.name: Sleek Web Design
keywords.definition: A modern, minimal site with clean lines, a small planned color palette, subtle hover effects and very even spacing.
keywords.when_to_use: Use for tech, finance, cars and modern product brands. Smart and safe, but it needs one bold idea to be memorable.
keywords.prompt_example: "homepage for an electric scooter brand, sleek web design, white and slate, one teal accent"

keywords.name: Slider Shot
keywords.definition: A short, smooth slide sideways, like the camera is sitting on a little rail.
keywords.when_to_use: Use it for polished product footage, where things up front glide past faster than things behind. Put something in the foreground, or the slide is hard to notice.
keywords.prompt_example: "smooth slider move past a pink cup, a blurred vase gliding by in the foreground"

keywords.name: Slot Machine Hook
keywords.definition: A pastel slot machine spins through options, slows with a satisfying click-click, lands on today's pick with a ding and a gold burst, then two comic panels explain it with zooms and pans.
keywords.when_to_use: Perfect as a series opener like tool of the day or pick of the week. It is a hook, not a whole video, so it needs a short explainer after it.
keywords.prompt_example: "15-second series opener, slot machine hook animation, pastel reels spinning and landing on today's pick with a gold burst"

keywords.name: Slow Motion
keywords.definition: Time stretched: motion rendered at high frame rate and played back slow, every detail savored.
keywords.when_to_use: Use for impact moments, beauty passes, and emotional peaks.
keywords.prompt_example: "slow motion, confetti falling around the champion"

keywords.name: Smash Cut
keywords.definition: An abrupt jarring cut between extremes: loud to silent, calm to chaos.
keywords.when_to_use: Use for shock, comedy, and waking from dreams badly.
keywords.prompt_example: "smash cut from the scream to the quiet breakfast table"

keywords.name: Smoke Bomb
keywords.definition: A burst of thick colored smoke filling the air around a subject. Pink, orange or teal clouds that swirl and glow in the light.
keywords.when_to_use: Use for bold fashion, wedding and music shots with big color. Pick one or two smoke colors for the cleanest look.
keywords.prompt_example: "dancer in a field with pink smoke bomb, backlit, golden hour"

keywords.name: Snap Zoom
keywords.definition: A split-second zoom from wide to tight.
keywords.when_to_use: Use for comedy beats, reactions and punchlines.
keywords.prompt_example: "snap zoom onto his face as he realises"

keywords.name: Snow Leopard
keywords.definition: A big wild cat with smoky gray fur, dark rosettes, pale eyes and a huge fluffy tail. It looks like winter itself turned into an animal.
keywords.when_to_use: Use for icy mountain scenes and quiet, powerful portraits. Say snow leopard in full, or you may get a regular leopard standing in snow.
keywords.prompt_example: "snow leopard resting on a snowy rock ledge, first snow, soft light"

keywords.name: Soap Bubble
keywords.definition: A thin floating sphere that swirls with rainbow colors on its skin, catching tiny reflections of the world around it.
keywords.when_to_use: Use for dreamy, playful and magical moments, and close-ups full of color. Great slow-moving in video too.
keywords.prompt_example: "giant soap bubble drifting over a meadow, rainbow swirls, golden hour"

keywords.name: Soft Clay Diorama
keywords.definition: A soft, glossy clay miniature world on a warm cream set, with pastel robots and simple clay people acting out each idea. The scenes hold still while clean type and graphics do the moving.
keywords.when_to_use: Great for friendly explainers and short educational reels. Because the pictures barely move, it relies on a good script and strong text animation to stay interesting.
keywords.prompt_example: "30-second explainer, soft clay diorama, glossy pastel clay robot on a cream set, still scene with bold serif captions wiping in"

keywords.name: Soft Grunge
keywords.definition: Grunge with the edges sanded: faded blacks, pastel accents, tumblr-era wistfulness.
keywords.when_to_use: Use for gentle rebellion in portraits and moody-but-kind scenes.
keywords.prompt_example: "portrait, soft grunge, faded film"

keywords.name: Soft Key
keywords.definition: Large diffused main light wrapping gently around faces; flattering and calm.
keywords.when_to_use: Use for beauty work, interviews, and trustworthy warmth.
keywords.prompt_example: "soft key portrait, window light, gentle falloff"

keywords.name: Soft Macabre
keywords.definition: Death and decay rendered gently: skulls in pastel, ghosts that look huggable.
keywords.when_to_use: Use for spooky subjects that should charm rather than frighten.
keywords.prompt_example: "still life with skull and roses, soft macabre"

keywords.name: Solarpunk
keywords.definition: A bright, hopeful future where cities are covered in gardens, solar panels and clean energy. Nature and technology get along.
keywords.when_to_use: Use for optimistic sci-fi and green city dreams. If it looks too plain, add details like rooftop farms, vines and stained glass.
keywords.prompt_example: "solarpunk city with rooftop gardens and white towers, sunny day"

keywords.name: Sound Effect Lettering
keywords.definition: Big, bursting comic words like POW, BOOM and CRASH, drawn in chunky shapes with outlines and jagged edges. The sound becomes part of the picture.
keywords.when_to_use: Use for action, comedy and anything loud. Short words work best; longer ones often get misspelled.
keywords.prompt_example: "sound effect lettering KABOOM over an exploding birthday cake, comic style"

keywords.name: Southern Gothic
keywords.definition: Stories set in the American South, where the beauty is a little rotten. Peeling mansions, Spanish moss, sticky heat, porch lights and strange, haunted families.
keywords.when_to_use: Use for eerie, humid, slow-burning scenes with faded grandeur. Keep it subtle, the spookiness comes from atmosphere, not monsters.
keywords.prompt_example: "southern gothic, decaying plantation house, spanish moss, dusk heat haze"

keywords.name: Spacious Web Design
keywords.definition: Generous white space, even padding and a steady grid make every section feel airy and easy to read.
keywords.when_to_use: Use for portfolios, wellness, galleries and any site with lots of reading. Needs strong content, or it can feel empty.
keywords.prompt_example: "website for a yoga retreat, spacious web design, wide margins, soft beige"

keywords.name: Spaghetti Western
keywords.definition: The dusty Italian-made westerns of the 1960s: squinting eyes in huge close-up, sun-baked desert towns, ponchos and long tense standoffs.
keywords.when_to_use: Use for gritty, sweaty, high-noon drama with lots of attitude. Pair with a close-up for that famous staring-down moment.
keywords.prompt_example: "spaghetti western standoff, dusty street, extreme close-up of squinting eyes"

keywords.name: Speckled Stoneware
keywords.definition: Sturdy handmade mugs and plates in creamy or oatmeal glaze dotted with tiny brown speckles, like a bird egg.
keywords.when_to_use: Use for cozy cafe tables and modern handmade kitchen scenes. Feels homey and current.
keywords.prompt_example: "speckled stoneware mug of coffee on a wooden table, morning light"

keywords.name: Speech Bubble
keywords.definition: The rounded balloon with a little tail that shows who is talking in a comic. Spiky ones shout, cloudy ones think, wobbly ones whisper.
keywords.when_to_use: Use to make any image feel like a comic panel. Keep the words to a few, since AI lettering can still come out jumbled.
keywords.prompt_example: "cat in a spacesuit, speech bubble saying hello, comic panel"

keywords.name: Speed Lines
keywords.definition: Sharp streaks bursting out from or racing behind a subject to show speed, impact or shock. Classic manga shorthand for 'something big just happened.'
keywords.when_to_use: Use for action, surprise and comedy beats. It's a drawn effect, so it fits illustrated styles better than photos.
keywords.prompt_example: "manga panel of a cat sprinting, speed lines, black and white"

keywords.name: Speed Ramp
keywords.definition: Footage accelerates or brakes mid-shot: real time snapping into slow motion and back.
keywords.when_to_use: Use for action emphasis and stylish energy shifts.
keywords.prompt_example: "speed ramp as the skater launches off the rail"

keywords.name: Speed Smear
keywords.definition: Something fast whips past the lens and its blur becomes the cut.
keywords.when_to_use: Use for racing, sport and anything fast.
keywords.prompt_example: "a car zooms past the lens and as the blur clears we are at the finish line"

keywords.name: Spiral Shot
keywords.definition: The camera circles the subject while rising, like a corkscrew.
keywords.when_to_use: Use for grand reveals, dream moments and big emotional lifts.
keywords.prompt_example: "the camera spirals up around the dancer and rises above the stage"

keywords.name: Splash Page
keywords.definition: A full comic page given to one huge, dramatic picture, usually a hero arriving or a big battle. No small panels, just one giant moment.
keywords.when_to_use: Use for epic, poster-like comic art where everything feels big. Works best with one clear subject and a strong pose.
keywords.prompt_example: "splash page, masked heroine landing on a rooftop, city below, dynamic ink"

keywords.name: Splash Shot
keywords.definition: A drink or fruit frozen mid-splash, with droplets and liquid crowns flying in the air. Fresh, bold and full of energy.
keywords.when_to_use: Use for drinks, fruit and juicy, refreshing ads. Pair with slow motion for video, or a frozen moment for stills.
keywords.prompt_example: "strawberry dropping into milk, splash shot, white background"

keywords.name: Staggered Reveal
keywords.definition: The words of a headline rise into place one after another, followed by the buttons, so the page seems to arrive in a gentle wave.
keywords.when_to_use: Use it for a page opening or a new section coming into view. Keep the delays short so the whole reveal finishes in about a second.
keywords.prompt_example: "Animate my hero so each word of the headline slides up into place one after another, then the buttons fade in after them."

keywords.name: Stained Glass
keywords.definition: Bold shapes outlined in dark lead, filled with glowing colored glass. Light becomes the artwork.
keywords.when_to_use: Use for spiritual, ornate, or fairytale imagery. Strong silhouettes work best.
keywords.prompt_example: "stained glass window of a fox in a moonlit forest"

keywords.name: Stained Glass Animation
keywords.definition: A window being made and lit: thick dark lead lines draw the design, then jewel-colored panes light up one by one, and a slow band of light passes behind them like the sun moving.
keywords.when_to_use: Beautiful for openers, holiday cards, faith or heritage stories and calm logo reveals. It is slow and ornate, so it does not suit quick edits or lots of text.
keywords.prompt_example: "12-second opener, stained glass animation, lead lines drawing a rose window, jewel panes lighting up one by one"

keywords.name: Startup Garage
keywords.definition: A scrappy workspace in a home garage: folding tables, laptops, tangled cables, whiteboards and pizza boxes. Big dreams, tiny budget.
keywords.when_to_use: Use for founder stories, origin moments and humble beginnings. Warm, practical lamp light makes it feel hopeful.
keywords.prompt_example: "two founders working late in a cluttered startup garage, laptops and whiteboard, warm lamp light"

keywords.name: Static Hold
keywords.definition: The camera does not move at all; the frame is a stage and life happens inside it.
keywords.when_to_use: Use for composed tableaux, comedy timing, and letting performance breathe.
keywords.prompt_example: "static hold on the doorway as chaos passes through"

keywords.name: Steadicam
keywords.definition: Stabilized floating movement that follows subjects smoothly through space, no track required.
keywords.when_to_use: Use for long following shots through doorways, corridors, and crowds.
keywords.prompt_example: "steadicam following him through the backstage corridors"

keywords.name: Steam Rising
keywords.definition: Soft wisps of steam curling up from hot food or drink. It tells the eye this is fresh and warm.
keywords.when_to_use: Use on soups, coffee, noodles and anything that should look hot. It shows up best against a dark background with light from the side or behind.
keywords.prompt_example: "cup of black coffee, steam rising, dark background, side light"

keywords.name: Steampunk
keywords.definition: A Victorian-style world run on steam, with brass gears, goggles, clockwork gadgets and airships.
keywords.when_to_use: Use for inventors, fantasy machines and old-world adventure. It is very popular, so add your own twist to stand out.
keywords.prompt_example: "steampunk inventor in a workshop full of brass gears"

keywords.name: Step Indicator
keywords.definition: A row of numbered circles joined by a line that shows where you are in a process with several steps. Finished steps turn into ticks and the line fills up as you move along.
keywords.when_to_use: Use it for sign-up flows, checkouts or set-up wizards so people know how much is left. With more than about five steps it starts to feel long, so group steps where you can.
keywords.prompt_example: "Add a 4 step progress bar for sign up, Account, Profile, Plan and Done, with circles joined by a line that fills and ticks each step as I press Next."

keywords.name: Stepper Buttons
keywords.definition: A small minus and plus pair with a number in the middle. Each tap nudges the number down or up by one.
keywords.when_to_use: Use it for small counts like tickets, guests or items in a cart. It gets slow for big numbers, so switch to a slider or a typed box there.
keywords.prompt_example: "Make a ticket counter with round minus and plus buttons around a big number that pops a little each time it changes, from 1 to 10."

keywords.name: Sticker Sheet
keywords.definition: A page of little die-cut stickers with white borders, each one a cute, simple picture on its own.
keywords.when_to_use: Use for cute sets of icons, animals or doodles in one image. Text on stickers often comes out jumbled, so stick to pictures.
keywords.prompt_example: "sticker sheet of happy vegetables, white borders, pastel colors"

keywords.name: Sticky Header
keywords.definition: The top bar of a page with the logo and menu stays pinned in place while everything else scrolls underneath. Once you start scrolling it shrinks a little and gains a soft shadow.
keywords.when_to_use: Use it on long pages so the menu and main button are always one click away. On small phone screens keep it slim so it does not eat the view.
keywords.prompt_example: "Keep my header pinned to the top, and make it shrink slightly with a soft shadow once the page scrolls"

keywords.name: Stippling
keywords.definition: Pictures built entirely from tiny dots. Dots packed close together make shadows; spread-out dots make light.
keywords.when_to_use: Use for old-book illustrations, botanical studies and ink portraits. It reads best in black and white with one clear subject.
keywords.prompt_example: "stippling ink drawing of a barn owl, white paper"

keywords.name: Stocky Build
keywords.definition: A short to medium height body that is solid, thick-set and sturdy, with a strong chest and wide stance. Grounded and powerful rather than tall.
keywords.when_to_use: Use for blacksmiths, chefs, farmers, wrestlers or any character who should feel solid and steady. Works for all genders.
keywords.prompt_example: "stocky blacksmith with a leather apron at a glowing forge"

keywords.name: Stop Motion
keywords.definition: Real little objects moved a tiny bit at a time and photographed frame by frame. Everything has a handmade, slightly jittery charm.
keywords.when_to_use: Use for cozy, crafty scenes with puppets, felt or toys. In video, expect a choppy rhythm; that's part of the magic.
keywords.prompt_example: "felt mouse baking bread in a tiny kitchen, stop motion"

keywords.name: Story Map
keywords.definition: An illustrated map that follows one journey, with a winding path and little scenes drawn at each stop along the way. It tells a whole story in one picture.
keywords.when_to_use: Use for adventures, children's books, travel memories and event posters. Keep the number of stops small so each scene stays clear.
keywords.prompt_example: "story map of a mouse's trip to the sea, winding dotted path, storybook style"

keywords.name: Storybook Cartoon Web Design
keywords.definition: A cheerful, cartoon-like site inspired by children's picture books: warm cream backgrounds, big bold headings, bright color blocks, thick black outlines and very rounded shapes.
keywords.when_to_use: Use for kids' products, picture books, family brands and playful apps. Too childlike for serious or premium brands.
keywords.prompt_example: "website for a children's bookshop, storybook cartoon web design, thick black outlines, bright blocks"

keywords.name: Storybook Illustration
keywords.definition: The gentle, detailed pictures you find in a children's picture book. Soft colors, friendly shapes, and a scene that feels like it's mid-story.
keywords.when_to_use: Use for warm, wholesome images that feel like a bedtime tale. Add a medium like watercolor or gouache to steer the look.
keywords.prompt_example: "badger reading by lantern light in a burrow, storybook illustration"

keywords.name: Storytelling Web Design
keywords.definition: A site that tells a story as you scroll, mixing big visuals, short punchy writing, Abril Fatface headlines and gentle animations that carry you from one moment to the next.
keywords.when_to_use: Use for charities, brand stories, product launches and personal journeys. It takes longer to read, so give visitors a quick way to skip ahead.
keywords.prompt_example: "scrolling story for an animal rescue charity, storytelling web design, big photos, short lines of text"

keywords.name: Storytime Animation
keywords.definition: The story-channel cartoon: a simple character with thick outlines snaps between a few poses, cuts to a big reaction close-up and holds still for the punchline.
keywords.when_to_use: Use for personal stories, funny mishaps and talking-to-camera content where the voice is the star.
keywords.prompt_example: "cartoon girl with big glasses shrugs at a computer full of code, storytime animation, thick outlines"

keywords.name: Street Tacos
keywords.definition: Small corn tortillas loaded with grilled meat, onion, cilantro and a squeeze of lime. Bright, messy and full of life.
keywords.when_to_use: Use for lively street food scenes and colorful, casual food shots. A paper plate or food truck backdrop keeps it real.
keywords.prompt_example: "three street tacos with lime wedges on a paper plate, food truck at dusk"

keywords.name: Subsurface Scattering
keywords.definition: The soft glow you see when light sinks into something and lights it from inside, like a backlit ear, a grape or a wax candle.
keywords.when_to_use: Use to make skin, fruit, jade or wax feel alive instead of plastic. It is subtle, so pair it with backlight to really see it.
keywords.prompt_example: "jade dragon figurine, subsurface scattering, backlit"

keywords.name: Succulents
keywords.definition: Plump, fleshy little plants growing in neat rosettes, in shades of sage, blue-green and dusty pink.
keywords.when_to_use: Use for desert gardens, tidy windowsills and soft, pastel plant arrangements. They look great from above.
keywords.prompt_example: "arrangement of succulents in terracotta pots, overhead, soft light"

keywords.name: Suminagashi
keywords.definition: Japanese paper marbling: ink floated on water, captured as delicate rings and drifts.
keywords.when_to_use: Use for organic flowing textures and meditative abstract backgrounds.
keywords.prompt_example: "suminagashi marbling, indigo ink rings"

keywords.name: Sunflower
keywords.definition: Tall stems carrying big golden faces with dark centers, all turned toward the light. Happy, warm and summery.
keywords.when_to_use: Use for cheerful countryside scenes, portraits in a field and warm yellow palettes. Late afternoon sun makes the petals glow.
keywords.prompt_example: "girl in a straw hat in a sunflower field, late afternoon light"

keywords.name: Sunglasses Portal
keywords.definition: The next scene plays reflected in a pair of sunglasses, and putting them on takes us there.
keywords.when_to_use: Use it for fashion, music or a change of mood. Keep the reflected scene simple so it still reads in the small lenses.
keywords.prompt_example: "a beach at sunset plays reflected in a pair of sunglasses; she puts them on and the camera pulls back to show her now on the beach"

keywords.name: Surrealism
keywords.definition: Dream logic painted with realistic detail: melting clocks, impossible deserts, long shadows and ordinary objects behaving in ways that make no sense.
keywords.when_to_use: Use for dreams, strange feelings and ideas you can't show literally.
keywords.prompt_example: "melting pocket watch draped over a tree branch in a desert at dusk, surrealism"

keywords.name: Surrealist Pop
keywords.definition: Pop-art gloss meets dream logic: familiar icons behaving impossibly.
keywords.when_to_use: Use for playful uncanny compositions with commercial shine.
keywords.prompt_example: "giant cherry floating over a diner, surrealist pop"

keywords.name: Swing Dance
keywords.definition: A joyful, bouncy partner dance with spins, kicks and lifts, straight out of old dance halls. Smiles and flying skirts.
keywords.when_to_use: Use for happy, vintage party scenes and big energy. Lifts and flips can tangle limbs, so keep it to spins and kicks.
keywords.prompt_example: "couple swing dancing, polka dot dress mid-spin, 1940s dance hall"

keywords.name: Swiss Bauhaus Animation
keywords.definition: A modernist poster that builds itself: circles, squares and bars in primary colors slide along a strict grid and lock into place, with clean left-aligned type snapping to the same lines. Moves are straight and snappy, never diagonal.
keywords.when_to_use: Ideal for design-minded brand intros, title cards and clean explainers. It is strict and cool, so it can feel cold for warm or emotional stories.
keywords.prompt_example: "8-second title card, swiss bauhaus animation, red circle and blue bars sliding onto a grid, sans serif type snapping in"

keywords.name: Sword and Sorcery
keywords.definition: Rough, muscle-and-magic adventure stories: lone warriors, ancient ruins, wicked sorcerers and treasure guarded by something terrible.
keywords.when_to_use: Use for bold, painted-paperback fantasy with plenty of action and danger. It is more gritty and personal than grand, kingdom-saving epic fantasy.
keywords.prompt_example: "sword and sorcery warrior in a jungle ruin, glowing idol, painted paperback cover"

keywords.name: Synchromism
keywords.definition: Early abstract movement painting with color the way composers use chords: rhythmic, swirling color harmonies.
keywords.when_to_use: Use for abstract pieces where color itself is the subject.
keywords.prompt_example: "abstract composition, synchromism style"

keywords.name: Synthwave
keywords.definition: A retro-future look from 80s electronic music: neon pinks and purples, glowing grid floors, chrome text and a striped setting sun.
keywords.when_to_use: Use for retro night drives, neon cityscapes and album-cover vibes. It is a strong look, so it can take over the whole image.
keywords.prompt_example: "synthwave sunset, neon grid road, palm silhouettes, purple sky"

keywords.name: Syrie Maugham
keywords.definition: English decorator (1879-1955) famous for her all-white room: white walls, white satin, white flowers and mirrored screens, all glowing together.
keywords.when_to_use: Use for bright, dreamy, all-white spaces with a 1930s elegance. Add one soft accent if the image feels washed out.
keywords.prompt_example: "all-white drawing room, mirrored screen, white lilies, Syrie Maugham style"

keywords.name: Syrup Drizzle
keywords.definition: A thin, glossy ribbon of syrup or honey flowing down onto food. It catches the light like liquid amber.
keywords.when_to_use: Use on pancakes, waffles and desserts for a sticky, sweet moment. Backlight makes the drizzle glow.
keywords.prompt_example: "honey drizzle onto a stack of waffles, backlit, golden light"

keywords.name: Tabletop Product Shot
keywords.definition: A slow push and drift across a styled table that settles on the product.
keywords.when_to_use: Use it for calm, tidy product footage of about 10 seconds. Name the props, or the table may fill up with clutter.
keywords.prompt_example: "slow push and drift across a linen tabletop with lemons and glasses, settling on a glass perfume bottle"

keywords.name: Tabs
keywords.definition: A row of labels across the top of a section, like folder tabs. Clicking one slides a coloured underline over to it and swaps the content below.
keywords.when_to_use: Use it to split related content into a few groups on one page, such as photos, videos and saved items. More than five or six tabs gets crowded.
keywords.prompt_example: "Add tabs for Photos, Videos and Saved with a pink underline that slides between them and a short fade when the content changes"

keywords.name: Tactile Art
keywords.definition: Art made to be touched: raised textures, sensory surfaces, sight optional.
keywords.when_to_use: Use for texture-forward compositions begging for fingertips.
keywords.prompt_example: "relief artwork of ocean waves, tactile art"

keywords.name: Tailored Suit
keywords.definition: A jacket and trousers cut to fit the body just right, with crisp shoulders, clean lines and no extra fabric. Smart, sharp and pulled together.
keywords.when_to_use: Use for professional portraits, weddings and confident characters of any gender. Add a fabric, like wool or linen, and a color for more control.
keywords.prompt_example: "man in a navy tailored suit, standing by a tall office window"

keywords.name: Tall and Lanky
keywords.definition: A long, thin body with long arms and legs, often a little gangly. They tower over the crowd and have to duck through doorways.
keywords.when_to_use: Use for characters with height as a natural part of who they are, from teen athletes to quiet bookworms. Add a scale clue, like a doorway or other people, so the height shows.
keywords.prompt_example: "tall and lanky young man ducking under a low cafe doorway, warm afternoon"

keywords.name: Tango
keywords.definition: A close, intense partner dance with sharp turns, leg flicks and dramatic dips. Sultry and full of tension.
keywords.when_to_use: Use for passionate, moody scenes and evening romance. Pairs well with dim, warm light and deep shadows.
keywords.prompt_example: "couple dancing tango, dramatic dip, dim smoky room, warm light"

keywords.name: Tap Dance
keywords.definition: Quick, rhythmic footwork in shoes with metal plates on the soles, clicking on a wooden floor. Bright, bouncy showmanship.
keywords.when_to_use: Use for playful, old-time stage vibes and fun footwork close-ups. The sound is the point, so pick it for video with audio when you can.
keywords.prompt_example: "close-up of tap shoes on a wooden stage, spotlight, vintage theater"

keywords.name: Teal and Orange
keywords.definition: The classic movie color combo: warm skin tones against cool teal shadows. Instantly cinematic.
keywords.when_to_use: Use for cinematic stills and action scenes. It is the fastest route to a film look.
keywords.prompt_example: "teal and orange street scene, cinematic still"

keywords.name: Technicolor
keywords.definition: Vintage three-strip saturation: reds that sing, greens that glow, Hollywood's candy era.
keywords.when_to_use: Use for retro musicals, dream sequences, and joyful artifice.
keywords.prompt_example: "1950s kitchen, technicolor grade"

keywords.name: Telenovela
keywords.definition: The glossy Latin American TV drama: grand staircases, gasps, tearful close-ups, big jewelry and secrets revealed in a sunny mansion.
keywords.when_to_use: Use when you want over-the-top romance and family drama with lots of feeling. It is meant to be a little much, so lean into it.
keywords.prompt_example: "telenovela scene, woman gasping on a marble staircase, dramatic zoom"

keywords.name: Telephoto Compression
keywords.definition: Long lenses stack distance flat: backgrounds loom huge and close behind subjects.
keywords.when_to_use: Use for surveillance moods, crowds pressed together, and mountains crowding a village.
keywords.prompt_example: "telephoto compression, commuters stacked in golden light"

keywords.name: Tenango Embroidery
keywords.definition: Hand-stitched designs from Otomi (Hñähñu) communities around Tenango de Doria in Hidalgo, Mexico. Playful animals, birds and plants in bright thread on white cotton, sometimes all in one color.
keywords.when_to_use: Use for joyful textile art, pillows, clothing and pattern backgrounds. Name the tradition instead of a vague 'Mexican pattern' to get the real look.
keywords.prompt_example: "Tenango embroidery of deer and flowers, rainbow thread on white cloth"

keywords.name: Tenderness
keywords.definition: Soft, caring closeness: a parent tucking in a child, hands cupping a baby bird, two foreheads touching. Gentle light and gentle gestures.
keywords.when_to_use: Use when you want warmth and love without big drama. Close framing and soft light do most of the work.
keywords.prompt_example: "tenderness, grandfather tying a little girl's shoelace, soft window light"

keywords.name: Terminal ASCII Animation
keywords.definition: A command line that tells the story: text types itself with a blinking cursor, pictures made of keyboard characters print line by line, and progress bars fill one character at a time. Nothing moves smoothly, it all changes in whole characters.
keywords.when_to_use: Perfect for coding, AI and tech explainers or a hacker-style intro. It is very text-heavy, so it is not the best choice for viewers who want pictures.
keywords.prompt_example: "15-second tech intro, terminal ascii animation, green text typing on black, ascii logo printing line by line"

keywords.name: Terracotta
keywords.definition: A warm, earthy orange-brown, the color of baked clay pots and roof tiles.
keywords.when_to_use: Use for sunny, rustic and Mediterranean-feeling scenes. It pairs beautifully with blues and greens, but can feel heavy with only browns.
keywords.prompt_example: "terracotta pots on a sunny balcony, olive trees"

keywords.name: Terracotta Web Design
keywords.definition: A sun-baked, earthy site on warm cream backgrounds, with ink-brown headlines in DM Serif Display and a single clay-orange accent.
keywords.when_to_use: Use for blogs, food writers, ceramics shops and long-form stories. The warm earthy palette suits handmade brands more than high-tech ones.
keywords.prompt_example: "blog for a slow food cook, terracotta web design, warm cream, brown serif headlines, clay accent"

keywords.name: Terrarium
keywords.definition: A tiny garden sealed inside glass: moss, ferns, pebbles and sometimes a little figurine. A whole world you can hold in your hands.
keywords.when_to_use: Use for dreamy miniature worlds and cozy shelf scenes. Glass reflections can get busy, so a dark or plain background helps.
keywords.prompt_example: "glass terrarium with moss, tiny ferns and a sleeping fox figurine"

keywords.name: Text Highlight Sweep
keywords.definition: A marker-pen colour sweeps across behind the words of a sentence, one line after another, as if someone is highlighting it while you watch. It pulls the eye to the key message.
keywords.when_to_use: Use it on one important line, such as a promise or a headline, to make it stand out. Used on too much text it stops meaning anything.
keywords.prompt_example: "Animate a pink marker highlight that sweeps behind this paragraph line by line when it appears"

keywords.name: Text Scramble
keywords.definition: The letters of a headline flicker through random characters, like a code being cracked, before settling into the real words from left to right.
keywords.when_to_use: Use it for techy, mysterious or playful headlines. Use it on one short line only; on long text it becomes hard to read.
keywords.prompt_example: "Make my headline do a text scramble: each letter flickers through random characters and settles into the real word, left to right."

keywords.name: Textbook Illustration
keywords.definition: Clear, carefully labeled drawings like the ones in school science and history books: cutaway views, neat arrows and calm, flat colors.
keywords.when_to_use: Use for explaining how things work, from volcanoes to the water cycle. Labels often come out as nonsense words, so plan to add real text later.
keywords.prompt_example: "textbook illustration of a volcano cutaway with labeled layers, clean flat colors"

keywords.name: Thought Bubble
keywords.definition: A puffy cloud above a character's head, joined by little circles, showing what they are secretly thinking or dreaming.
keywords.when_to_use: Use for daydreams, inner jokes and wishes. Describe what is inside the bubble, or AI may leave it empty.
keywords.prompt_example: "little girl at a window, thought bubble showing a flying whale"

keywords.name: Three-Person Dialogue Coverage
keywords.definition: One take that covers three people talking in a room, moving between each face, over-the-shoulder views and a wide.
keywords.when_to_use: Use it for conversation scenes where everyone needs screen time. It runs about 30 seconds; say who sits where, or faces can blend together.
keywords.prompt_example: "three friends talk at a kitchen table; slow push between them, over-the-shoulder on each, ending on the wide"

keywords.name: Three-Quarter View
keywords.definition: The face or body turned halfway between front and side, so you see both eyes and the curve of the cheek. The classic, most flattering portrait angle.
keywords.when_to_use: Use for natural portraits and character art that feels more alive than straight on. For a full side view, use profile shot instead.
keywords.prompt_example: "three-quarter view portrait of an old fisherman, window light"

keywords.name: Through the Leaves
keywords.definition: The photo is taken from behind blurry leaves or flowers close to the lens, so the subject peeks out from soft green shapes.
keywords.when_to_use: Use for candid, hidden-observer moments and lush nature portraits. Ask for the leaves out of focus so they frame instead of block.
keywords.prompt_example: "woman reading on a bench, shot through the leaves, soft green blur"

keywords.name: Through the Window
keywords.definition: Looking at the subject through glass, with reflections, raindrops or a window frame between you. It feels private, quiet and a little cinematic.
keywords.when_to_use: Use for cozy, lonely or watching-from-outside moods. Add rain or steam on the glass for extra feeling.
keywords.prompt_example: "woman reading in a cafe, seen through the window, rain on glass, night"

keywords.name: Tilt Shift Miniature
keywords.definition: A real street or beach seen from above that suddenly looks like a tiny toy model, with a thin strip of sharp focus, dreamy blur at the top and bottom, bright toy colors and little cars and people zipping about in quick bursts.
keywords.when_to_use: Charming for travel reels, city promos and event recaps. It works best on high-angle shots, and it looks odd on close-ups or eye-level footage.
keywords.prompt_example: "15-second travel reel, tilt shift miniature, busy market from above looking like a toy model, people zipping around"

keywords.name: Tilt Up
keywords.definition: The camera pivots vertically upward, revealing height or hope.
keywords.when_to_use: Use for reveals of scale: buildings, giants, skies, futures.
keywords.prompt_example: "tilt up from muddy boots to the mountain peak"

keywords.name: Tintype
keywords.definition: An old portrait printed straight onto a thin metal plate, popular in the 1860s. Dark silvery tones, soft edges and serious faces staring right at you.
keywords.when_to_use: Use for haunting old-time portraits and Western or Victorian characters. Expect a dark, moody result, not a cheerful one.
keywords.prompt_example: "tintype portrait of a cowboy, 1860s, scratched plate edges"

keywords.name: Tiptoeing
keywords.definition: Creeping along on the very tips of the toes, shoulders hunched, trying not to make a sound. Instantly sneaky and funny.
keywords.when_to_use: Use for playful mischief, cartoon sneaking and bedtime scenes. Add a sleeping pet or parent to show what they are sneaking past.
keywords.prompt_example: "small boy tiptoeing past a sleeping dog toward the cookie jar, night kitchen"

keywords.name: Toast Notification
keywords.definition: A small message card that slides in near the corner of the screen to say something happened, then slides away by itself. It pops up like toast from a toaster.
keywords.when_to_use: Use it to confirm quick actions like Saved or Copied without stopping the person. Do not use it for errors people must fix, because it disappears.
keywords.prompt_example: "Show a toast notification in the bottom corner that slides up saying Picks saved, with a tick and a shrinking timer bar, then slides away"

keywords.name: Toggle Switch
keywords.definition: An on and off switch shaped like a small pill. Clicking it slides the round knob across and the track changes colour to show it is on.
keywords.when_to_use: Use it for settings that take effect straight away, like dark mode. For choices that only apply after pressing Save, a tick box is clearer.
keywords.prompt_example: "Make a settings list with toggle switches where the knob slides across and the track turns pink when a setting is on"

keywords.name: Toile
keywords.definition: French pastoral scenes printed in single-color repeat on cream; storytelling as pattern.
keywords.when_to_use: Use for elegant patterned backgrounds and wallpaper-style illustration.
keywords.prompt_example: "garden scene, toile de jouy pattern, indigo on cream"

keywords.name: Tonalist
keywords.definition: Late-1800s American landscape mood: soft diffused light, muted unified color, dawn-and-dusk reverie.
keywords.when_to_use: Use for misty contemplative landscapes where atmosphere outranks detail.
keywords.prompt_example: "marsh at dusk, tonalist painting"

keywords.name: Tooltip
keywords.definition: A small label with a pointer arrow that fades in above something when you hover the mouse over it. It fades away when the mouse leaves.
keywords.when_to_use: Use it to explain a small icon or setting in a few words. Phones have no hover, so never put must know information only in a tooltip.
keywords.prompt_example: "Add a tooltip to the info icon that fades in above it with a little pointer arrow and says Saves every 30 seconds"

keywords.name: Toyism
keywords.definition: Dutch movement of bright, toy-like figurative art made by pseudonymous collective artists.
keywords.when_to_use: Use for playful narrative scenes with candy color and cartoon geometry.
keywords.prompt_example: "harbor town, toyism style"

keywords.name: Tracking Shot
keywords.definition: The camera travels alongside a moving subject, keeping pace like a companion.
keywords.when_to_use: Use for walks, chases, and any journey the viewer should take with the character.
keywords.prompt_example: "tracking shot following her down the market street"

keywords.name: Trash Polka
keywords.definition: German tattoo style colliding photorealism with black-and-red graphic chaos.
keywords.when_to_use: Use for edgy graphic portraits and tattoo-design energy.
keywords.prompt_example: "portrait, trash polka style, black and red"

keywords.name: Trompe l'Oeil
keywords.definition: French for 'fools the eye'. A flat painting so realistic it looks like real windows, doors or objects popping out of the wall.
keywords.when_to_use: Use for murals, painted ceilings and walls that seem to open up. It shines most when you show the flat wall around the painting.
keywords.prompt_example: "trompe l'oeil mural of an open window to the sea on a brick wall"

keywords.name: Truck Shot
keywords.definition: The whole camera slides sideways past the subject, so near and far things move at different speeds.
keywords.when_to_use: Use for smooth product glides and reveals with a real sense of depth.
keywords.prompt_example: "the camera trucks left past the coffee cup on the desk"

keywords.name: Tudor Revival
keywords.definition: Storybook houses with dark wooden beams crossing white walls, steep pointed roofs, tall chimneys and small diamond-paned windows.
keywords.when_to_use: Use for fairytale villages, English cottages and cozy old manor houses. Can look like a theme park if everything is too clean, so add age.
keywords.prompt_example: "Tudor Revival cottage with ivy, misty morning, village lane"

keywords.name: Tufted Ottoman
keywords.definition: A low padded footstool or bench with buttons pressed into the cushion, making a pattern of soft puffs.
keywords.when_to_use: Use as a cozy, luxurious detail in living rooms and dressing rooms. Small, so it works best as part of a scene.
keywords.prompt_example: "blush velvet tufted ottoman at the foot of a bed, soft morning light"

keywords.name: Turquoise
keywords.definition: A sky-blue to green stone, often with dark web-like veins running through it. Loved for centuries in jewelry from Persia, Tibet and the American Southwest.
keywords.when_to_use: Use for bold silver jewelry, desert styling and earthy color accents. Name the culture or style you want, since turquoise traditions are rich and specific.
keywords.prompt_example: "chunky silver cuff bracelet set with turquoise stones, desert sand, warm light"

keywords.name: Twirling
keywords.definition: Spinning around with skirts, coats or hair flaring out in a circle. It feels joyful, light and a little romantic.
keywords.when_to_use: Use for happy portraits, dresses and dance scenes. A long, flowy outfit makes the motion much easier to see.
keywords.prompt_example: "little girl twirling in a yellow dress in a sunflower field"

keywords.name: Typographic Art
keywords.definition: Letterforms as the artwork itself: type arranged into image, pattern, or portrait.
keywords.when_to_use: Use for word-driven posters and letter-built imagery.
keywords.prompt_example: "lion made of typography"

keywords.name: Tyrian Purple
keywords.definition: An ancient reddish purple dye made from sea snails. It was so costly to make that it became the color of emperors and kings.
keywords.when_to_use: Use for royal robes, rich fabrics and ancient feeling scenes. The AI may just give a regular purple, so add 'deep reddish purple'.
keywords.prompt_example: "queen in tyrian purple robes, torchlit marble hall"

keywords.name: Ukiyo-e
keywords.definition: Old Japanese woodblock prints come to life: each shot is one finished print on soft paper, flat color blocks slightly off their black lines, a fading sky and a red seal. The camera slides from print to print like unrolling a scroll, with only small things moving.
keywords.when_to_use: Beautiful for travel, food, culture and calm storytelling. Most of the frame stays still on purpose, so do not expect big action.
keywords.prompt_example: "20-second travel story, ukiyo-e animation, woodblock print of a wave and mountain, rain falling, camera sliding to the next print"

keywords.name: Ukiyo-e Vaporwave
keywords.definition: Classic Japanese woodblock composition dressed in neon pinks, teals, and retro-digital sunset gradients.
keywords.when_to_use: Use for striking wall art and content that bridges traditional and internet aesthetics.
keywords.prompt_example: "ukiyo-e vaporwave great wave, neon sunset grid"

keywords.name: Ultramarine
keywords.definition: A deep, glowing blue first made by grinding the stone lapis lazuli. In the Renaissance it could cost more than gold.
keywords.when_to_use: Use for heavenly skies, sacred art and rich blue robes. It leans slightly purple, so ask for cobalt blue if you want a cleaner blue.
keywords.prompt_example: "angel in ultramarine robes, gold leaf halo, fresco"

keywords.name: Under-Pass Shot
keywords.definition: The camera flies low, right under or between the subject, and out the other side.
keywords.when_to_use: Use it for impossible shots no real camera crew could get. Give the subject clear space underneath, like a raised truck or a jumping horse.
keywords.prompt_example: "the camera flies low, passes right under a parked truck and out the other side, then looks back"

keywords.name: Undercut Snap
keywords.definition: Starts at ankle height, snaps up to the face, glides around, then snaps back down.
keywords.when_to_use: Use it to go from a small detail to the whole person with some punch. It works best on a subject standing fairly still.
keywords.prompt_example: "start at ankle height on a boxer's shoes, snap up to his face, glide round, snap back down"

keywords.name: Underwater City
keywords.definition: A whole town under the sea, with glass domes, glowing windows and fish drifting past the streets.
keywords.when_to_use: Use for dreamy fantasy and sci-fi worlds. Add light words like light rays or bioluminescence, or it can look murky.
keywords.prompt_example: "underwater city of glass domes, light rays, schools of fish"

keywords.name: Unease
keywords.definition: That quiet feeling that something isn't right. Too-empty rooms, a door left open, a figure standing a little too still at the end of the hall.
keywords.when_to_use: Use for gentle creepiness without monsters or gore. Small strange details work better than one big scary thing.
keywords.prompt_example: "unease, empty motel corridor at night, one door ajar, flickering light"

keywords.name: Unlikely Friends
keywords.definition: Two characters who shouldn't get along, sharing a quiet moment together. A tiny mouse and a huge bear, a knight and a dragon having tea.
keywords.when_to_use: Use for heartwarming, funny or gentle storytelling images. The bigger the difference between them, the sweeter it reads.
keywords.prompt_example: "unlikely friends, wolf and lamb sharing an umbrella in the rain"

keywords.name: Urban Sketch
keywords.definition: A sketchbook page drawn on location: thin brown pen lines that wobble and never quite close, then see-through watercolor drops in on top, spilling past the lines and fading into cream paper at the edges.
keywords.when_to_use: Great for travel reels, city guides, cafes and architecture stories. It is loose and arty, so it is not the right pick for precise technical diagrams.
keywords.prompt_example: "20-second city guide, urban sketch animation, sepia pen drawing a corner cafe, then loose watercolor washing in"

keywords.name: Vantablack
keywords.definition: One of the darkest materials ever made, a black so deep it swallows almost all light. Objects coated in it look like flat holes cut out of the world.
keywords.when_to_use: Use for eerie, mind-bending objects and dramatic contrast. AI can only fake it, so expect a very deep black rather than true lightlessness.
keywords.prompt_example: "vantablack sphere on a white marble floor, gallery light"

keywords.name: Vaporwave
keywords.definition: Internet nostalgia from the 2010s: pink and teal neon, a striped setting sun, a grid floor rolling to the horizon, VHS fuzz and Greek statues in a shopping-mall daydream.
keywords.when_to_use: Use for retro-future music art, playful tech nostalgia and anything that should feel like 1987 seen through a dream.
keywords.prompt_example: "palm trees and a striped sunset over a neon grid, vaporwave, VHS glitch"

keywords.name: Vector Art
keywords.definition: Clean, smooth shapes with sharp edges and flat or simple gradient fills, like a modern app illustration or a logo. No brush texture at all.
keywords.when_to_use: Use for icons, stickers, posters and tidy graphics. It can look generic, so give it a strong palette or an unusual subject.
keywords.prompt_example: "vector art of a lighthouse at sunset, flat colors, clean shapes"

keywords.name: Velvet
keywords.definition: Deep, soft, light-absorbing fabric texture. Rich and touchable, with gentle sheen on the folds.
keywords.when_to_use: Use for luxury, warmth, and depth, especially in dark and moody scenes.
keywords.prompt_example: "emerald velvet armchair in a dim study"

keywords.name: Verdigris
keywords.definition: The chalky blue-green crust that grows on old copper, brass and bronze, like on old statues and church roofs.
keywords.when_to_use: Use for aged metal, fantasy ruins and steampunk details. It is a texture as much as a color, so it shines on metal surfaces.
keywords.prompt_example: "verdigris copper dome above a foggy old city"

keywords.name: VHS Horror
keywords.definition: Scary movie footage that looks like it was played on a worn-out home video tape. Fuzzy colors, wobbly lines, soft blur and a creepy, homemade feeling.
keywords.when_to_use: Use when you want horror that feels found, cheap and a little too real. It hides detail on purpose, so it is not the choice for crisp images.
keywords.prompt_example: "vhs horror still, empty hallway at night, tape glitches, washed colors"

keywords.name: Vibrant Web Design
keywords.definition: A lively, colorful site with bold, playful Fascinate headings, warm accent colors and lots of visual energy.
keywords.when_to_use: Use for festivals, food, kids' brands and summer campaigns. Needs calm spaces between sections or it can feel overwhelming.
keywords.prompt_example: "website for a taco truck, vibrant web design, hot orange and turquoise, playful headings"

keywords.name: Victorian Era
keywords.definition: The 1800s look: ornate detail, dark wood, lace, gas lamps, and formality with secrets.
keywords.when_to_use: Use for gothic romance, period portraits, and moody interiors.
keywords.prompt_example: "victorian era study, gas lamp, leather books"

keywords.name: Vincent van Gogh
keywords.definition: (1853-1890) Dutch painter of swirling skies, thick bold brushstrokes and glowing yellows and blues. Everything feels alive and moving.
keywords.when_to_use: Use for expressive night skies, sunflowers and countryside scenes full of energy. It is very recognizable, so it can take over a prompt.
keywords.prompt_example: "starry night over a sleepy fishing harbor, in the style of Vincent van Gogh"

keywords.name: Vintage Web Design
keywords.definition: A nostalgic site that borrows from the 1950s to the 1990s, with grainy textures, faded retro colors, touches that copy real objects and Silkscreen pixel lettering.
keywords.when_to_use: Use for thrift stores, record labels, retro games and heritage brands. Grain and pixel type can feel dated if overused.
keywords.prompt_example: "website for a thrift store, vintage web design, grainy faded colors, pixel lettering"

keywords.name: Vinyl Record
keywords.definition: A black disc with fine grooves spinning on a turntable, the needle resting gently on top. Warm, analog and nostalgic.
keywords.when_to_use: Use for retro music moods, cozy listening corners and close-up texture shots. Spinning works nicely in video too.
keywords.prompt_example: "vinyl record spinning on a turntable, warm lamp light, record sleeves behind"

keywords.name: Visual Music
keywords.definition: Non-representational animation-style imagery that visualizes sound: rhythm as shape and color.
keywords.when_to_use: Use for synesthetic abstracts and music-driven visuals.
keywords.prompt_example: "symphony visualized, visual music, flowing forms"

keywords.name: Vivian Maier
keywords.definition: (1926-2009) American street photographer who secretly took well over 100,000 photos while working as a nanny. Square black and white street moments and clever self-portraits in shop windows.
keywords.when_to_use: Use for mid-century city street scenes and reflection self-portraits. Set it in the 1950s or 1960s for the real flavor.
keywords.prompt_example: "woman's reflection in a shop window, 1950s Chicago street, in the style of Vivian Maier"

keywords.name: Volumetric Light
keywords.definition: Light you can see traveling through the air, like sunbeams through dust or fog. Adds instant atmosphere and depth.
keywords.when_to_use: Use when a scene feels empty; visible light rays fill space beautifully. Forests, churches, and windows love this.
keywords.prompt_example: "old library, volumetric light through tall windows"

keywords.name: Vorticism
keywords.definition: British 1914 movement of sharp angular energy: machine-age dynamism in fractured geometry.
keywords.when_to_use: Use for bold angular compositions radiating speed and force.
keywords.prompt_example: "city in motion, vorticism"

keywords.name: Wabi-Sabi
keywords.definition: Japanese aesthetic of imperfection and impermanence: cracked glazes, weathered wood, quiet asymmetry.
keywords.when_to_use: Use for serene compositions where flaws are the beauty.
keywords.prompt_example: "tea bowl still life, wabi-sabi"

keywords.name: Watercolor
keywords.definition: Soft, translucent paint that bleeds and blooms on paper. Edges melt; colors breathe.
keywords.when_to_use: Use for gentle, emotional, storybook feels. Terrible for sharp detail; wonderful for mood.
keywords.prompt_example: "watercolor painting of a rainy street market"

keywords.name: Watercolor Animation
keywords.definition: A nature journal that paints itself: see-through brush strokes with dry-brush streaks on warm cotton paper, big shapes first and small details last, with a quiet handwritten note beside each subject. Finished plants sway gently.
keywords.when_to_use: Lovely for nature, travel, wellness and gentle educational videos. Painting in takes time, so it does not suit fast cuts.
keywords.prompt_example: "20-second nature explainer, watercolor animation, a tree painting itself trunk to leaves on cotton paper, handwritten note beside it"

keywords.name: Watercolor Ornamental
keywords.definition: Decorative watercolor pattern-work: florals, vines, and scrollwork in soft translucent layers.
keywords.when_to_use: Use for elegant borders, stationery, and decorative motifs.
keywords.prompt_example: "ornamental watercolor border, wildflowers"

keywords.name: Watercolor Over Photograph
keywords.definition: A real photo with loose watercolor washes painted on top, so parts of the picture melt into soft, colorful paint.
keywords.when_to_use: Use to make a photo feel like a memory or a travel journal page. Faces can get blurred, so say where the paint should go.
keywords.prompt_example: "street photo of Venice, watercolor over photograph, paint bleeding at the edges"

keywords.name: -wave
keywords.definition: Borrowed from music names like vaporwave and synthwave, -wave suggests a retro, nostalgic mood with a strong color palette. Often glowy, dreamy and a little surreal.
keywords.when_to_use: Use when you want an image to feel like a remembered era or a soundtrack. Results lean pink, purple and neon, so name other colors if you want them.
keywords.prompt_example: "synthwave desert highway, glowing sunset, grid horizon"

keywords.name: Weathered
keywords.definition: Aged by time and the elements. Peeling paint, worn wood, soft rust. Surfaces that have lived a life.
keywords.when_to_use: Use to add character and honesty to objects and places. New and shiny often reads as fake; weathered reads as real.
keywords.prompt_example: "weathered fishing boat on a grey beach"

keywords.name: Weaving
keywords.definition: Threads crossed over and under on a loom to make cloth, rugs and wall hangings, with visible texture and stripes.
keywords.when_to_use: Use for cozy textiles, handmade rugs and textured art pieces. Name colors and patterns to guide it.
keywords.prompt_example: "handwoven wall tapestry in rust and cream stripes, loom in the corner"

keywords.name: Wet-on-Wet
keywords.definition: Wet paint dropped onto paper that is already wet, so colors bloom, bleed and feather into each other. Soft, unpredictable and lovely.
keywords.when_to_use: Use for skies, misty backgrounds, flowers and dreamy moods. You give up control, so don't expect sharp lines.
keywords.prompt_example: "wet-on-wet watercolor of a stormy sea sky"

keywords.name: Whimsigoth
keywords.definition: 1990s witchy maximalism: celestial prints, jewel tones, tapestries, moons on everything.
keywords.when_to_use: Use for cozy-mystical interiors and characters with strong tarot energy.
keywords.prompt_example: "bedroom interior, whimsigoth, celestial tapestry"

keywords.name: Whip Pan
keywords.definition: A pan so fast the frame smears; snaps attention from one thing to the next.
keywords.when_to_use: Use for comedy beats, energy spikes, or hiding a cut inside the blur.
keywords.prompt_example: "whip pan from her shocked face to the door"

keywords.name: Whiteboard Animation
keywords.definition: A hand-drawn explainer where a pen sketches simple pictures, arrows and words on a board while the narrator talks, then pulls back to show the whole idea as one map.
keywords.when_to_use: Use to explain processes, relationships and step-by-step ideas alongside a voiceover.
keywords.prompt_example: "marker draws a clock, an arrow and a lightbulb on a chalkboard, whiteboard animation"

keywords.name: Whiteboard Brainstorm
keywords.definition: A team gathered around a whiteboard covered in sticky notes, arrows and quick sketches, pointing and thinking out loud.
keywords.when_to_use: Use for teamwork, planning and creative problem-solving images. Writing on the board will usually be gibberish, so keep it in soft focus or crop it out.
keywords.prompt_example: "diverse team in a whiteboard brainstorm, colorful sticky notes, bright meeting room"

keywords.name: Wide Angle Lens
keywords.definition: Short focal length exaggerates depth and space; rooms stretch, faces distort up close.
keywords.when_to_use: Use for dynamic environments, cramped tension, or comedic distortion.
keywords.prompt_example: "wide angle lens, tiny apartment feels like a canyon"

keywords.name: Wide Shot
keywords.definition: Full body visible with generous surroundings; the scene's geography stays honest.
keywords.when_to_use: Use for establishing action, choreography, and physical comedy.
keywords.prompt_example: "wide shot of the family kitchen, everyone in frame"

keywords.name: Wild Poppies
keywords.definition: Bright red, paper-thin petals with dark centers, nodding in tall grass. Delicate, cheerful and a little bit wild.
keywords.when_to_use: Use for summer meadows, nostalgic countryside and pops of red. They look lovely swaying in the wind on video.
keywords.prompt_example: "meadow of wild poppies swaying in the wind, golden hour"

keywords.name: Windsor Chair
keywords.definition: A classic wooden chair with a solid carved seat and a back made of many thin spindles, often in a hoop shape.
keywords.when_to_use: Use for farmhouse kitchens, old taverns and cozy cottages. Feels old-fashioned in the best way.
keywords.prompt_example: "Windsor chairs around a scrubbed pine table, cottage kitchen"

keywords.name: Wireframe Render
keywords.definition: The 3D object is drawn as a see-through mesh of thin glowing lines, like the skeleton of a computer model.
keywords.when_to_use: Use for tech, sci-fi and blueprint moods. It reads best on a dark background, and busy scenes can turn into a tangle of lines.
keywords.prompt_example: "sports car wireframe render, cyan lines on black"

keywords.name: Wise Mentor
keywords.definition: The calm, older guide who teaches the hero, often with a walking staff, a long beard or a cup of tea. Patient, knowing and a little mysterious.
keywords.when_to_use: Use for fantasy, training and coming-of-age scenes. Try unexpected ages, settings or styles so it doesn't feel stale.
keywords.prompt_example: "wise mentor teaching a young apprentice by a mountain fire"

keywords.name: Wisteria
keywords.definition: Long, hanging clusters of purple or white flowers dripping from vines over arches and walls. Like a flower waterfall.
keywords.when_to_use: Use for fairytale gardens, romantic walkways and dreamy spring scenes. Light coming through the blooms adds magic.
keywords.prompt_example: "wisteria tunnel in full bloom, soft light through purple flowers"

keywords.name: Wood-Fired Pizza
keywords.definition: A round pizza with puffy, charred, blistered edges, fresh from a glowing brick oven. Bubbling cheese and a bit of basil on top.
keywords.when_to_use: Use for rustic kitchen scenes and warm, glowing food shots. The fire in the oven behind adds lovely warm light.
keywords.prompt_example: "wood-fired pizza on a peel, glowing brick oven behind, basil leaves"

keywords.name: Wood-Fired Pottery
keywords.definition: Pots baked for days in a wood-burning kiln, so flying ash melts into drippy glaze and flame marks paint warm browns, oranges and greens.
keywords.when_to_use: Use for rustic, natural pottery that looks touched by fire. Every surface is uneven, which is the charm.
keywords.prompt_example: "wood-fired jar with ash glaze drips, stone shelf, warm side light"

keywords.name: Woodblock Print
keywords.definition: Pictures printed from carved wooden blocks, one block per color, with flat areas of color and wood grain sometimes showing through.
keywords.when_to_use: Use for Japanese-style landscapes, waves and gentle folk scenes. Pairs well with soft natural colors.
keywords.prompt_example: "woodblock print of a mountain village in snow, indigo and red"

keywords.name: Woodcut and Linocut Animation
keywords.definition: A carved relief print coming to life: bold shapes in one or two inks stamp down onto textured paper with a heavy press, and carving lines cut themselves in. Each layer lands with a thump, slightly speckled and a little off.
keywords.when_to_use: Strong for folk tales, craft brands, music videos and anything that wants a handmade, earthy weight. It is chunky by design, so fine detail and soft gradients get lost.
keywords.prompt_example: "15-second folk tale opener, woodcut and linocut animation, black and red ink layers stamping onto rough paper"

keywords.name: Workflow Board UI
keywords.definition: A clean, high-contrast workspace where you drag and drop blocks to connect data, apps and steps into an automatic workflow, with structured panels and Ubuntu and Oswald type.
keywords.when_to_use: Use for automation tools, project boards and no-code builders (apps you set up without writing code). Too busy and technical for a simple brand site.
keywords.prompt_example: "automation builder screen, workflow board ui, connected blocks on a grid, side panel"

keywords.name: Worm's-Eye View
keywords.definition: The view from the very ground looking straight up, as if you were a worm. Trees, buildings and people tower over you.
keywords.when_to_use: Use to make anything look huge, heroic or dizzying. It is more extreme than a plain low angle.
keywords.prompt_example: "worm's-eye view of skyscrapers and a lone tree, blue sky"

keywords.name: Wuxia
keywords.definition: Chinese martial arts adventure where swordsmen and swordswomen glide across rooftops, bamboo tops and lakes. Flowing robes, misty mountains and graceful, floating fights.
keywords.when_to_use: Use for elegant action that feels more like dance than brawling. Great with slow motion and fog for that drifting, weightless look.
keywords.prompt_example: "wuxia swordswoman leaping across bamboo treetops, flowing robes, misty valley"

keywords.name: Y2K
keywords.definition: Late 90s to early 2000s: glossy plastic, chrome, bubble shapes, digital optimism.
keywords.when_to_use: Use for playful nostalgia and fashion-forward content aimed at millennial memory lanes.
keywords.prompt_example: "y2k desktop setup, translucent plastic, chrome accents"

keywords.name: Y2K Chrome Animation
keywords.definition: A shiny millennium dream: liquid chrome blobs melt into hearts and stars, mirror type glints as a highlight sweeps across it, and bubbly windows pop open over a candy pink and baby blue sky.
keywords.when_to_use: Great for fashion, beauty and music reels with a nostalgic, glossy feel. The shine is the whole point, so it can look cheap if the chrome is flat or dull.
keywords.prompt_example: "10-second beauty reel, y2k chrome animation, liquid chrome hearts melting, glinting mirror type on a candy pink sky"

keywords.name: YInMn Blue
keywords.definition: A vivid, electric blue pigment discovered by accident in a university lab in 2009. Named after the elements in it: yttrium, indium and manganese.
keywords.when_to_use: Use when you want a blue that feels brighter and more modern than royal blue. The AI may not know it well, so add 'vivid electric blue' too.
keywords.prompt_example: "ceramic vase glazed in YInMn blue, vivid electric blue, white studio"

keywords.name: Yume Kawaii
keywords.definition: Dreamy-cute Japanese style: pastel clouds, stars, and fairy-tale sweetness with a faint melancholy underneath.
keywords.when_to_use: Use for soft dreamy characters where cute carries a hint of ache.
keywords.prompt_example: "pastel dreamscape portrait, yume kawaii"

keywords.name: Yves Saint Laurent
keywords.definition: French designer Yves Saint Laurent (1936-2008) put women in tuxedos with his famous Le Smoking suit, and loved safari jackets, sheer blouses and bold blocks of color inspired by art.
keywords.when_to_use: Use for confident, sleek 1960s and 1970s Parisian style. Great for tuxedo looks and dramatic black and white fashion portraits.
keywords.prompt_example: "woman in a black tuxedo suit in the style of yves saint laurent, paris street at night"

keywords.name: Zaha Hadid
keywords.definition: Iraqi-British architect (1950-2016) known for buildings that swoop and flow like liquid, with no straight corners. Smooth white curves that look like they are in motion.
keywords.when_to_use: Use for sleek, futuristic buildings and spaces that feel fast even standing still. Too much of it can look like a generic sci-fi set, so add a real place or material.
keywords.prompt_example: "opera house of flowing white curves at dusk, Zaha Hadid style"

keywords.name: Zombie Formalism
keywords.definition: Slick, market-friendly abstraction; process-heavy, meaning-light, gallery-wall ready.
keywords.when_to_use: Use for contemporary abstract pieces with polished emptiness as the point.
keywords.prompt_example: "large abstract canvas, zombie formalism"

keywords.name: Zoom
keywords.definition: The camera stays still and only the lens zooms, so the background flattens as it closes in.
keywords.when_to_use: Use for a watchful, documentary feel, or a 1970s film look.
keywords.prompt_example: "slow zoom in from the wide street to her face in the crowd"

keywords.name: Zoom Burst
keywords.definition: Zooming the lens while the photo is taken, so streaks shoot out from the center like you are flying forward.
keywords.when_to_use: Use for energy, speed and excitement, like a city at night rushing at you. The center stays clearest, so put your subject there.
keywords.prompt_example: "zoom burst photo of busy street lights at night"
